nota: Ejercicios aprovechables de los módulos 1-7 y de los 25 juegos, sin duplicados. Fichas a reescribir en palabras propias citando la fuente. Diagramas originales no fiables: redibujar desde el texto. Módulos 8-10 descartados (plantillas repetidas).

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare the body, footwork and ball control.
ejercicios.organizacion: 20 x 20 m square. Every player has a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble freely. On the signal, they change direction, perform a sole roll, a cut or a short acceleration.
ejercicios.variantes: Weak foot only; maximum two touches; swap balls with another player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Head up, small touches, knees bent, ball kept close to the foot.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate the body and establish accurate passing.
ejercicios.organizacion: 10 x 10 m squares, four players in each square.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Pass to the next player and move to the free cone. Add a joint-mobility action on the return.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; change direction; mandatory open first touch.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Dynamic footwork, firm ground pass, open receiving position.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Work on passing, movement and body orientation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Triangles measuring 8 to 10 m per side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A passes to B, B controls toward C, and C sets the ball back to A. Players follow their pass.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; double pass; movement before receiving.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Open the body, scan before receiving and pass accurately.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine footwork frequency with ball mastery.
ejercicios.organizacion: Course with an agility ladder followed by a slalom.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player works through the ladder, collects a ball, dribbles through the cones and accelerates to the finish.
ejercicios.variantes: Weak foot; tighter slalom; acceleration with a change of direction.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Quality footwork, balance, close control and acceleration after the skill.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate scanning and short passing.
ejercicios.organizacion: 10 x 10 m square, four players outside and one defender inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The outside players keep possession. The defender changes after winning the ball or when an error is made.
ejercicios.variantes: Two touches; one touch; increase or reduce the area.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Body orientation, support angle and communication.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare the ankles, hips and changes of direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Lines of six cones spaced 2 m apart.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble through the slalom, jog back and repeat with a new technical variation.
ejercicios.variantes: Inside of the foot; outside of the foot; alternate right and left foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Progressive rhythm, stable upper body and controlled ball contact.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate passing and the reaction after releasing the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two lines facing each other, 12 m apart.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Pass to the partner, then sprint toward a side cone before joining the opposite line.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch pass; open first touch; sprint right or left on the signal.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Pass quality, explosive first step and scan before receiving.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link receiving, passing and intelligent movement.
ejercicios.organizacion: 12 x 12 m diamond with players at each cone.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball moves around the diamond. After passing, the player follows the ball or switches position as instructed.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a central support player; one touch; reverse direction.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Body position, passing angle and movement immediately after the pass.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Raise body temperature while working with the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Free 25 x 25 m area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble freely. On signals, perform hip openers, heel flicks or side steps, then return to the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Add feints; 5 m acceleration; weak-foot dribbling.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Progressive rhythm, safe spacing and constant ball control.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate the quality of the first touch.
ejercicios.organizacion: 12 x 12 m square with players positioned on the outside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Pass clockwise. The receiver takes the first touch forward and passes to the next player.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse direction; one touch; add a passive defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: First touch into the path, support foot directed forward and firm pass.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate quick feet before receiving and carrying the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build two lanes with a short footwork section and a ball station.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Complete the footwork pattern, receive the ball and dribble through the final gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the footwork pattern; weak foot; finish with a 5 m sprint.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Light, fast contacts; balanced posture; first touch forward.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate support angles and quick decisions in possession.
ejercicios.organizacion: 12 x 12 m square with five attackers and two light defenders.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Keep the ball with controlled pressure. Rotate defenders after a win or clear error.
ejercicios.variantes: Two touches; one touch after five passes; adjust the area.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan early, create clear angles and keep the ball moving.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Warm up combination play and movement after the pass.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs or groups of three in 12 m channels.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A passes to B, moves forward, receives the set pass and plays to the next station.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch on the set; diagonal run; finish through a gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Set into the path, run immediately and communicate.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate coordination, passing and movement in pairs.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs move inside a marked area with one ball between them.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players alternate short passes while adding mobility actions between receptions.
ejercicios.variantes: Increase distance; one touch; include side steps or hip openers.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep moving, pass to the safe foot and maintain spacing.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare changes of direction and ball protection.
ejercicios.organizacion: 12 x 5 m channels, one ball for each pair.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball carrier dribbles and changes direction while the partner follows without making contact.
ejercicios.variantes: Increase speed; add a gate to cross.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Protect the ball, lower the centre of gravity and accelerate after the feint.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop close control and awareness while moving through gates.
ejercicios.organizacion: Scatter 12 to 20 small gates inside a 20 x 20 m area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble through as many gates as possible without repeating the same route.
ejercicios.variantes: Weak foot; colour sequence; partner chase.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Head up, change pace after each gate and avoid collisions.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Raise intensity progressively through repeated movement waves.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set two or three lanes, with groups starting in waves of three.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players move forward using passes, mobility actions and short accelerations, then jog back.
ejercicios.variantes: Crossed runs; two-touch limit; finish in a mini-goal.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Pass into the run and keep the waves well spaced.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve reaction speed and first movement on a signal.
ejercicios.organizacion: Players work in pairs around coloured cones with a ball nearby.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the coach signal, react to the colour or direction, then complete a short technical action.
ejercicios.variantes: Visual signal; sound signal; add a 1v1 race to the ball.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay on the front foot, react before accelerating and keep control.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate passing rhythm and scanning in several directions.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a star with one central cone and five outside points.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball travels through the centre and out to a new point. Players follow or rotate.
ejercicios.variantes: Use two balls; one touch; reverse the pattern.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Check shoulders, pass firmly and arrive balanced.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link control, dribbling and passing.
ejercicios.organizacion: Circuit with a receiving station, slalom and final pass.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player receives, takes an open first touch, dribbles through the slalom and passes to the next player.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a feint; weak foot; time the circuit without losing quality.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: First touch, fluid movement and accuracy of the final pass.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine possession with constant movement around the area.
ejercicios.organizacion: Square with outside players allowed to move between sides and one or two defenders inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Keep possession while the passer changes side to create a new angle.
ejercicios.variantes: Two touches; one touch after a set number of passes; shrink the area.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move after passing, support on different lines and communicate.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare players for receiving and controlling aerial balls.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs 8 to 12 m apart inside safe channels.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players serve lofted balls, control them and return with a short pass.
ejercicios.variantes: Thigh control; chest control; add a short movement before receiving.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Track the ball early, cushion the touch and stay balanced.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop coordination and changes of direction by copying a partner.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs inside 8 x 8 m squares, one ball per player.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Leader dribbles and changes speed or direction; partner mirrors the action.
ejercicios.variantes: Switch leader every 30 seconds; weak foot; add a stop-turn.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay under control, keep the head up and react smoothly.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare passing quality while a defender applies light pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Groups of three in a 10 x 8 m rectangle: two passers and one passive defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The defender closes space without tackling while the passers adjust angle and body position.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow interceptions; two-touch limit; change defender quickly.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Receive side-on, protect the passing lane and play away from pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Increase scanning and communication with two balls moving at once.
ejercicios.organizacion: 12 x 12 m square with players at the corners and two balls starting opposite each other.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Both balls circulate continuously. Players call, receive and pass without collisions.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse one ball; one-touch on one side; add central movement.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before receiving and keep a steady rhythm.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate the lower body and quick foot contacts progressively.
ejercicios.organizacion: Short stations with mobility, low hurdles and a ball action at the end.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Complete the movement pattern, then receive, dribble or pass before rotating.
ejercicios.variantes: Add lateral work; increase rhythm; finish with a short acceleration.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Soft landings, controlled posture and progressive intensity.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Introduce three-player combinations during the warm-up.
ejercicios.organizacion: Triangles or diamonds with a central support player.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A plays to B, B sets back to A, and A finds C running forward. Rotate after every action.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; C starts on the signal; switch sides.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Timing of the run, pass to the correct foot and body orientation.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve ball control and awareness in limited space.
ejercicios.organizacion: 20 x 20 m area with many players dribbling at the same time.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players keep moving, change direction and find free space without contact.
ejercicios.variantes: Different ball surfaces; colour signals; exchange balls on command.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Head up, small touches and early changes of direction.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate communication and positional rotation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Square or rectangle with fixed starting positions.
ejercicios.desarrollo: After the pass, two players switch positions while the ball continues to circulate.
ejercicios.variantes: Mandatory movement; one touch; free switch after the signal.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Communicate, scan before passing and synchronise the movement.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate short acceleration while maintaining ball control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 8 to 12 m lanes with a ball at each start point.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players accelerate with the ball, brake inside the end zone and return at an easy pace.
ejercicios.variantes: Start from different positions; weak foot; reaction start.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Explosive first steps, ball within playing distance and controlled stop.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.material: cones, balls, three colours of bibs
ejercicios.objetivo: Improve orientation and scanning in a directional rondo.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark three target sides or colours around a rondo area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: After a set number of passes, the team must play toward the called colour.
ejercicios.variantes: Two touches; one touch; defender can block one target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before the call, open the body and support early.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Build a continuous passing rhythm with players always moving.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a rectangle with two players at each end and moving support players inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Pass, move to a new line and receive again without stopping the flow.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; change direction; add a second ball.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move before the pass arrives and keep distances consistent.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine lateral footwork with a precise pass.
ejercicios.organizacion: Footwork lane beside a short passing station.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Move laterally through the markers, receive from a server and play a firm return pass.
ejercicios.variantes: Different footwork patterns; weak foot; pass after a short sprint.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay low, face forward and set the feet before passing.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate support play by finding a target player quickly.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two teams in a grid with one captain or target player in each end zone.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams keep the ball and score by passing to their captain under control.
ejercicios.variantes: Limit touches; captain moves along the line; bonus after five passes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create width, play forward when possible and support the receiver.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare acceleration, deceleration and close control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Straight or diagonal lanes with a marked braking zone.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble at increasing speed, stop the ball inside the zone and change direction.
ejercicios.variantes: Different stopping surfaces; weak foot; reaction command.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Lower the hips, shorten steps before braking and keep the ball close.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop quick footwork and reaction to visual information.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place four coloured cones around each player or pair.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Perform quick foot contacts in the centre, then react to the called colour and play the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Sound cue; partner points; add a short pass after the reaction.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay balanced, react from the first step and accelerate under control.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect possession with an immediate transition after the ball changes teams.
ejercicios.organizacion: Rondo area with attackers outside and two defenders inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: When defenders win the ball, they complete a short exit pass before roles change.
ejercicios.variantes: Time limit for the exit; two touches; add a target gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: React instantly to loss, secure the first pass and switch roles quickly.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare technique and movement for longer ground or lofted passes.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs or groups of three, 18 to 25 m apart.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Start with firm ground passes, then add driven or lofted passes with controlled reception.
ejercicios.variantes: Move closer or farther; weak foot; add a supporting player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Support foot beside the ball, follow-through toward the target and cushion the first touch.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Work on support, set passes and runs into space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Y-shaped organisation with a central start and two exits.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A plays to B, B sets the ball, and A passes to C or D running into the called branch.
ejercicios.variantes: Switch sides; one touch; add a light finish at the end.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Clear movement, pass into the run and change of pace.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Activate passing, movement and awareness through small gates.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs with several gates spread across a 20 x 20 m area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Partners score by passing through a gate and moving to a different one.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch through the gate; use only the weak foot; add a time challenge.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Pass through the middle of the gate and move immediately.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Introduce defensive posture and controlled pressure at low intensity.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs in short channels, attacker with the ball and defender at walking or jogging pace.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Defender closes the angle and guides the attacker without full tackling.
ejercicios.variantes: Increase speed; add a gate to protect; switch roles after each action.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Side-on stance, bend the knees and avoid diving in.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Pass, Control and Open Up in Fours
ejercicios.objetivo: Warm up receiving, body orientation and support in groups of four.
ejercicios.organizacion: Four players form a diamond or square around a central space.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Pass, take an open first touch and move to support the next receiver.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; reverse direction; add a central passive defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan early, open the hips and pass to the correct foot.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare the whole body through a complete progressive circuit.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create four stations: mobility, footwork, dribbling and passing.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Groups rotate every two to three minutes, increasing the rhythm gradually.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a finishing station; team relay; weak-foot round.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Quality before speed, short explanations and smooth rotations.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve possession by using a neutral player to create support.
ejercicios.organizacion: 4v2 or 5v2 rondo with one neutral player available to the team in possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Use the neutral player to change angle and maintain circulation.
ejercicios.variantes: Neutral one touch; neutral inside or outside; directional target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the neutral player early and keep good spacing.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop close control and hip mobility in a figure-eight pattern.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two cones 4 to 6 m apart, one ball per player or line.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Dribble in a figure eight around the cones with controlled changes of foot and direction.
ejercicios.variantes: Inside only; outside only; accelerate out of each turn.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Small touches around the cones and head up between turns.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate passing with crossed movement after the ball is released.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two diagonal lines facing each other with crossing lanes in the middle.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Pass forward, make a crossed run and join the opposite line.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; add a set pass; finish through a gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Time the crossing run, avoid collisions and pass into the receiver’s path.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Bring the warm-up closer to real play with a small possession game.
ejercicios.organizacion: 4v4 to 6v6 in a compact area, with optional outside support players.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams keep possession and score through passes, gates or target players.
ejercicios.variantes: Touch limit; bonus for switching play; transition to mini-goals.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create width, support behind the ball and react immediately to loss.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve first-touch direction when receiving from different angles.
ejercicios.organizacion: Players receive from diagonal servers into a marked exit lane.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Check away, receive on the back foot and move the first touch into the next action.
ejercicios.variantes: Weak foot; passive pressure; add a final pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before receiving and let the first touch escape pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Integrate goalkeepers into the team warm-up with footwork and distribution.
ejercicios.organizacion: Goalkeepers work between goal actions while outfield players pass and move nearby.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Include short distribution, handling, footwork and a light finishing action.
ejercicios.variantes: Driven pass; aerial service; goalkeeper joins possession.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Clear communication, safe service and progressive intensity.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create energy and concentration before training.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two teams, several gates and scoring zones.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players score points by completing technical actions: crossing a gate, completing a pass or dribbling through a slalom.
ejercicios.variantes: Add foot-specific challenges; time limits; team bonuses.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Controlled intensity, accuracy and team spirit.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the task in under 45 seconds, start quickly and make short corrections while the drill is running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Build accurate ground passing and immediate movement after releasing the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set up a 10 to 12 m triangle or square with players distributed at the cones.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player passes to the next teammate and follows the pass. Keep the ball moving continuously with an open first touch.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; reverse direction; use the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Firm ground pass, open body and movement as soon as the ball leaves the foot.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop the timing of the pass and the run after a set.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 10 m triangles with two players at the starting cone and one at each other cone.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Sole Control and Change of Footing
ejercicios.objetivo: Secure the ball under pressure and change the supporting foot efficiently.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a central receiving zone with two exit gates. A passive defender closes one side of the receiver.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player stops or drags the ball with the sole, shifts the supporting foot and turns out through the free gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce the space; change the defender starting side; require a pass immediately after the turn.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay low and balanced. Keep the sole contact soft, move the body first and protect the ball during the turn.
ejercicios.consejo: Judge the control by whether the ball remains playable, not simply by whether it stops.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop a soft first touch from simple aerial service.
ejercicios.organizacion: Work in pairs 6 to 8 m apart. One player serves underarm while the partner controls inside a small box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Control with the foot, thigh or chest, settle the ball and pass back along the ground. Change roles every six serves.
ejercicios.variantes: Alternate surfaces; control toward a side gate; increase the height gradually; add a second action after control.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Track the ball, relax the receiving surface and cushion the contact by moving with the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: Start with accurate service. Poor service turns a control exercise into a survival exercise.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive securely while a defender applies realistic but controlled pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 12 x 10 m area with a target player at each end. The defender starts one step behind the receiver.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks toward the ball, controls and connects with the opposite target while the defender applies passive pressure.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow the defender to intercept a poor touch; limit touches; reverse roles after each repetition.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Feel the defender, keep a strong base and use the arm legally to protect space without pushing.
ejercicios.consejo: Increase defensive pressure only when the receiver is consistently controlling into safe space.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve body shape and awareness before the ball arrives.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create triangles of 10 m. The receiver begins in the middle and checks to one side to receive.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The passer calls a color or number behind the receiver. The player scans, opens the body and plays to the third point.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch pass; add a passive defender; change the information signal at the last moment.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before moving, arrive side-on and receive on the back foot whenever possible.
ejercicios.consejo: Correct the body before correcting the touch. Good orientation solves many technical problems early.

ejercicios.objetivo: Build confidence and control with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a short circuit with receiving, inside-outside touches, a turn and a final pass into a small goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Complete every technical action with the weaker foot. Use the stronger foot only for balance and emergency adjustment.
ejercicios.variantes: Count successful passes; reduce time; add a passive defender at the final gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use correct ankle position, take smaller touches and accept a slower rhythm while quality develops.
ejercicios.consejo: Keep the task achievable. Repetition with success builds the weaker foot faster than constant failure.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect a useful first touch with accurate passing and immediate movement.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place players around a 12 x 12 m square with at least two players at the starting cone.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Receive across the body, pass to the next station and move quickly to support the following action.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse direction; use two balls; require a give-and-go at every second cone.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: First touch across the body, pass to the correct foot and move as soon as the ball leaves.
ejercicios.consejo: The session should flow. Stop it only for a correction that benefits the whole group.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Close Ball Control in Tight Space
ejercicios.objetivo: Keep the ball under control while moving through a crowded area.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 16 x 16 m square. Every player has a ball and moves freely inside it.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players use small touches and change direction whenever another player enters their path. Add technical commands on the whistle.
ejercicios.variantes: Shrink the area; weaker foot only; steal another ball while protecting your own; add stop-start actions.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Head up between touches, low center of gravity and use different foot surfaces.
ejercicios.consejo: Crowded does not mean chaotic. Demand safe spacing and controlled speed.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve first touch and ball orientation through different receiving angles.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 12 x 10 m diamond with players at each point and two players at the start.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Pass around the diamond. Each receiver controls into the next passing line and follows the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a central bounce player; reverse direction; use one-touch sets at the top point.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move off the cone, receive on the back foot and keep the first touch away from the marker.
ejercicios.consejo: Change the angle frequently so players do not repeat the same comfortable body shape.

ejercicios.objetivo: Protect the ball and connect play when receiving with the back to the target.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 12 x 8 m channel. A server faces a receiver who starts with a passive defender behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks toward the pass, secures the ball, sets it back or turns out depending on the coach signal.
ejercicios.variantes: Defender becomes active; allow a third-player run; finish by dribbling through an exit gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use a wide base, check the shoulder and keep the first touch on the safe side.
ejercicios.consejo: Teach the receiver to decide before contact: set, hold or turn.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a body feint before the first touch to create an exit angle.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a mannequin or pole in front of the receiver with one gate on each side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: As the pass arrives, the receiver feints toward one gate and controls across the mannequin through the other.
ejercicios.variantes: Coach calls the exit late; add passive pressure; finish with a pass or shot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Sell the feint with the shoulders and eyes, then accelerate after the touch.
ejercicios.consejo: The feint creates the space; the first touch must immediately use it.

ejercicios.objetivo: Turn a positive first touch into an explosive forward action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 15 m lanes with a receiving line, a 5 m control zone and a finishing gate.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Receive a firm pass, push the first touch beyond the control zone and accelerate through the gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Different pass angles; weaker foot; chasing defender starts after the first touch.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Touch into stride, lean forward and make the first three steps explosive.
ejercicios.consejo: A positive touch should increase speed, not force the player to slow down and recover the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control firm or lofted passes over longer distances.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs work 18 to 25 m apart with a 4 m receiving box at each end.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players alternate driven and clipped passes. The receiver controls inside the box and plays back after two or three touches.
ejercicios.variantes: Control forward out of the box; add a side target; use thigh or chest before the pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Read the flight early, move the feet, relax on contact and keep the ball within playing distance.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not stand and wait under the ball. Adjust early, then become balanced before contact.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive and progress inside a narrow channel.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two 18 x 4 m channels with a passing line at one end and a mini-goal at the other.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks short, controls forward inside the channel and passes into the mini-goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Add passive side pressure; require an outside-foot touch; finish after a half-turn.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the line as a reference, keep the first touch straight and avoid crossing the feet.
ejercicios.consejo: A narrow channel exposes heavy touches immediately. Keep the distance realistic for the age group.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop the habit of taking the first touch forward when space is available.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set two lines 12 m apart with a central receiving marker and an exit gate 5 m beyond it.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks toward the ball, opens the body and takes the first touch through the forward gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Pass from different angles; add a defender who recovers from behind; finish with a pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan for space, receive on the back foot and touch beyond the cone without losing control.
ejercicios.consejo: Forward is a decision, not a rule. Players must first confirm that the space is free.

ejercicios.objetivo: Secure possession after receiving under contact pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs work inside 8 x 8 m boxes. One attacker receives while the defender starts one arm length away.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker controls, shields for three seconds and exits through either gate. Rotate roles after each action.
ejercicios.variantes: Defender starts from the side; shorten the shielding time; add a support pass to finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Place the body between opponent and ball, bend the knees and keep the ball on the far foot.
ejercicios.consejo: Protection should lead to the next action. Do not let players shield without looking for an exit.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve close touches and rapid foot adjustments.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set lines of eight markers 1 to 1.5 m apart. Keep groups small to reduce waiting.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Dribble through using inside-outside touches, then accelerate 5 m after the final cone.
ejercicios.variantes: Weaker foot; sole rolls; alternate feet; timed run with a technical penalty for missed cones.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take many light touches, keep knees bent and move the feet around the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: Timing is useful only when the technical route remains clean.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Control After a Change of Pace
ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain first-touch quality after accelerating or slowing down.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 20 m route with a jog zone, acceleration zone and receiving station.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player changes pace on the coach signal, arrives at the receiving marker and controls the pass into the next zone.
ejercicios.variantes: Receive after a lateral shuffle; add a turn; require the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Regain balance before contact, shorten the final steps and keep the head steady.
ejercicios.consejo: Fatigue and speed reveal poor preparation. Correct the approach steps before the touch.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control and transfer the ball between connected spaces.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build two 10 x 10 m squares side by side with a 3 m central gate.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players circulate in the first square, then a receiver controls through the central gate and starts circulation in the second.
ejercicios.variantes: Two balls; one-touch inside each square; add a defender in the central gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan the next square, prepare the angle and make the transfer touch decisive.
ejercicios.consejo: The central touch should change the picture, not simply move the ball a few meters.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive between pressure and space, then turn efficiently.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a receiver between a passer and two forward gates. A pole or passive defender represents pressure from behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks both shoulders, receives on the back foot and half-turns through the free gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Add an active defender; one gate is called late; finish with a pass to a target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan twice, open the hips and use one touch to receive and turn when possible.
ejercicios.consejo: The half-turn begins before the pass with information and body position.

ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate the first touch, footwork and short dribbling with the outside of the foot.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a circuit with a receiving station, a directional gate and a final passing target.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players receive across the body with the outside of the foot, dribble briefly and complete the action with a pass.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse the route; use the weaker foot for a full series; reduce the receiving area.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Lock the ankle, contact the outside surface cleanly and direct the touch into open space.
ejercicios.consejo: Use both feet in every series so the movement becomes functional on either side.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use the inside of the foot accurately when space and time are limited.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 10 x 10 m area with four small exit gates and one receiver in the middle.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The coach calls a gate as the pass travels. The receiver controls with the inside of the foot and exits within three touches.
ejercicios.variantes: Smaller gates; add passive pressure; call a fake gate first and change the command.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Present a firm surface, cushion the ball and keep the supporting foot pointed toward the exit.
ejercicios.consejo: Constraints should sharpen the touch, not force rushed technique. Adjust the space when errors dominate.

ejercicios.objetivo: Orient the first touch toward goal and prepare the next attacking action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a receiver 12 to 15 m from a mini-goal, with a server behind and an optional defender to one side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player checks away, receives, turns toward goal and finishes with a pass or controlled shot.
ejercicios.variantes: Defender becomes active; limit to two touches before the finish; receive from diagonal angles.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Check the shoulder, receive across the body and keep the final touch at a playable shooting distance.
ejercicios.consejo: Ask the player to see the goal before receiving, not after the turn.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link a clean first touch with a short, controlled dribble.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 12 m lanes with a receiving cone, three dribbling markers and an exit gate.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Receive at the first cone, dribble through the markers and pass through the exit gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Different receiving angles; weaker foot; final pass after a wall set.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: First touch into the route, ball close during the slalom and head up before the final pass.
ejercicios.consejo: The first touch and dribble should feel like one continuous action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve reaction, coordination and close control through imitation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs face each other in 8 x 6 m boxes. The leader has the ball; the partner mirrors without a ball at first.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The leader performs turns, rolls and direction changes. The partner mirrors, then both repeat with a ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Change leader every 30 seconds; coach calls required moves; add a race through an exit gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use small touches, stay balanced and react without crossing the feet unnecessarily.
ejercicios.consejo: Keep work periods short. Quality drops quickly when players mirror at maximum intensity for too long.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive accurately while moving diagonally across the field.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a starting cone, diagonal receiving gate and final target 8 m beyond.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player makes a diagonal run, receives into the path and plays the next pass without stopping.
ejercicios.variantes: Pass from either side; one-touch finish; chasing defender begins behind the runner.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Angle the run, communicate early and cushion the pass into the next stride.
ejercicios.consejo: The pass and run must agree. Adjust service before blaming the receiver.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control under pressure and set the ball accurately for a supporting player.
ejercicios.organizacion: Groups of three form a triangle. A passes to B, while C supports underneath.
ejercicios.desarrollo: B receives with a defender represented by a pole, protects the ball and sets it back to C, who plays forward to A.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch set; add an active defender; rotate the supporting angle.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Set the ball with the correct weight, keep it away from pressure and move after the layoff.
ejercicios.consejo: A set pass is successful when the next player can play forward without adjusting.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop continuous close control with frequent touches.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 18 x 18 m area with scattered markers and several small gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players move continuously, changing surface every five touches and passing through a new gate on the signal.
ejercicios.variantes: Weaker foot only; sole rolls; stop-start commands; reduce the area.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Touch the ball every step or two, keep the ankle relaxed and look up regularly.
ejercicios.consejo: Close control is not staring at the ball. Build moments when players must scan and still keep it close.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive in a central area and choose the best exit under pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 12 x 12 m central square with four outside targets and one receiver inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: An outside player passes in. The receiver scans, controls away from a passive defender and connects with a different target.
ejercicios.variantes: Two central receivers; active defender; points for playing through the opposite side.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Check all shoulders, receive on the safe foot and move the ball away from the defender line.
ejercicios.consejo: Central players need information before the ball. Pause the drill only to highlight missed scans.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive between defensive lines with an open body and forward intention.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create three horizontal zones. A receiver operates in the middle zone with a defender behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The back player passes between lines. The receiver controls and connects with a forward target or turns if space is free.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a second defender; limit touches; allow a bounce pass to escape pressure.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Arrive at an angle, scan both sides and receive beyond the cover shadow.
ejercicios.consejo: The movement before the pass is as important as the touch. Players must become visible to the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate control, footwork and a lateral exit from pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a receiving station with one gate to each side and a final passing target.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players receive, take the first touch sideways through the called gate and complete a short pass.
ejercicios.variantes: Two-touch maximum; reduce the gate width; add a passive defender from behind.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Prepare the body, direct the first touch into the side space and keep the ball close.
ejercicios.consejo: Use both feet so players can escape efficiently to either side.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve foot-surface variety, rhythm and ball control through a technical route.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a slalom with wide cones, tight markers, a turn pole and an exit gate.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players complete each section with a specified technique, then accelerate out and pass to the next player.
ejercicios.variantes: Alternate feet; timed challenge; add a final wall pass; reverse the route.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Adjust touch length to the space, stay low through turns and accelerate only after control is secure.
ejercicios.consejo: A technical circuit should teach decisions too. Occasionally let players choose the fastest clean route.

ejercicios.objetivo: Cushion an aerial ball and flow directly into controlled dribbling.
ejercicios.organizacion: A server stands 8 m from a receiving box followed by a 10 m dribbling lane.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The server lofts the ball. The receiver controls with foot, thigh or chest and dribbles through the exit gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Different heights; weaker side; add a passive defender after the first touch.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move into line with the ball, relax the receiving surface and bring it down into the route.
ejercicios.consejo: The second action shows the quality of the aerial control. The ball should already be ready to move.

ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain first-touch quality when time and pressure increase.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 10 x 8 m stations with two exit gates. A defender starts three meters away.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the pass, the defender closes down. The receiver has four seconds to control and exit through a gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce to three seconds; defender starts closer; add a final pass into a target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan early, choose the exit before contact and avoid taking the ball back into pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: Use the clock to create urgency, not panic. Reward correct decisions as well as speed.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control accurately after a run, change of direction or quick footwork.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place an agility section before a receiving cone and a passing target beyond it.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player completes the movement pattern, checks to receive and controls into the final pass.
ejercicios.variantes: Lateral shuffle; curved run; short sprint; receive from opposite sides.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Slow the final steps, regain balance and prepare the receiving foot before the ball arrives.
ejercicios.consejo: Players often blame the touch when the real error happened in the final approach steps.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link visual information to the direction and surface of the first touch.
ejercicios.organizacion: A receiver stands between two colored gates. A coach or teammate displays a color behind the player.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player scans before the pass, receives and exits through the matching gate without looking back again.
ejercicios.variantes: Use numbers; change the signal late; add passive pressure; require a specific foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan early and briefly, keep the body half-open and trust the information after the ball arrives.
ejercicios.consejo: Scanning has value only when it changes the decision. Ask players what they saw.

ejercicios.objetivo: Protect a received ball and turn away from pressure into free space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Work in 9 x 7 m boxes with a receiver, server and defender starting behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver secures the pass, holds off the defender and turns through either side gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Defender active immediately; require a sole turn or outside hook; finish with a pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Wide base, ball on the far side, feel the defender and turn when the pressure shifts.
ejercicios.consejo: The receiver should not fight the defender. Use the defender movement to choose the exit.

ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare a shot with an efficient first touch.
ejercicios.organizacion: Position servers at two angles 12 to 16 m from goal. Mark a receiving zone at the edge of the area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player receives, takes one directional touch and finishes quickly into the target area.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch finish; weaker foot; passive defender closing from behind; change service angle.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: See the target early, place the first touch outside the feet and strike without extra adjustment.
ejercicios.consejo: A perfect first touch for finishing creates a clear shooting line and the correct distance from the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use inside, outside, sole, instep, thigh and chest with control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Players work in a 20 x 20 m area with four technique stations around the outside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Move freely and complete the called surface at each station before changing direction.
ejercicios.variantes: Technical sequence of four surfaces; weaker side; partner service for aerial contacts.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Choose the right surface, soften the contact and maintain balance throughout the sequence.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not rush through every surface in one minute. Give players enough repetitions to feel each contact.

ejercicios.objetivo: Read the bounce and bring an unpredictable ball under control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Pairs work 8 to 12 m apart. The server throws or passes the ball so it bounces before reaching the receiver.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver adjusts the feet, controls after the bounce and passes back through a gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Different bounce heights; wet or firmer service; control with thigh or outside foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Watch the ball through the bounce, stay light on the feet and avoid reaching with a stiff leg.
ejercicios.consejo: Vary the service, but keep it realistic. The aim is adaptation, not random difficulty.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control, turn and escape when space is limited.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 6 x 6 m boxes with a receiver, server and two small exit gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver takes the pass, performs a selected turn and exits without touching the boundary.
ejercicios.variantes: Active defender; coach calls the turn; reduce the box; weaker foot exit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the ball under the body, bend the knees and accelerate after completing the turn.
ejercicios.consejo: The turn must protect the ball first. Speed comes after the body is between pressure and ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use the first touch to prepare a pass while hiding the intended direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a central receiving point with two target gates at different angles.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver controls with an open body, looks toward one target and passes through the other.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch disguise; add a passive defender; change targets at the last moment.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the first touch central enough to access both sides and sell the disguise with eyes and hips.
ejercicios.consejo: Disguise should not reduce passing quality. The ball still needs the correct weight and angle.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control speed and stop the ball cleanly under command.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 15 m lanes with stop lines every five meters.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble at changing speeds and stop the ball dead on the called line using the sole or inside of the foot.
ejercicios.variantes: Turn after the stop; accelerate from a stationary ball; weaker foot only.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Shorten touches before the line, lower the body and place the stopping foot over the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: A clean stop is a control skill, not a brake at the last second. Teach players to prepare it early.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive and move through constantly changing passing angles.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 10 m triangles. One player moves inside while three outside players circulate the ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The inside player receives from one side, controls toward another and passes out before moving to a new angle.
ejercicios.variantes: Two inside players; one-touch set followed by a turn; passive defender enters the triangle.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep moving before and after the pass, receive side-on and play away from the previous passer.
ejercicios.consejo: The triangle should stay alive. Static players remove the main learning objective.

ejercicios.objetivo: Carry technical control into a realistic 1v1 action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a short mastery route leading into a 12 x 10 m duel area with two mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker completes the route, receives a pass and immediately attacks the defender in the duel zone.
ejercicios.variantes: Different mastery move; defender starts late; score within six seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Finish the technical route balanced, take the first touch toward space and attack with intent.
ejercicios.consejo: The pre-duel work should prepare the player, not exhaust them. Keep it short and sharp.

ejercicios.objetivo: Choose and execute the first touch against an active opponent.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 12 x 10 m area with two exit gates. The attacker checks from the center while a defender marks from behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The passer plays in. The attacker receives, turns or sets depending on pressure and tries to exit through a gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a support player; score for forward exit; defender may intercept the initial pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan the defender, use the safe foot and make the first touch decisive.
ejercicios.consejo: Allow different solutions. A safe set can be better than forcing a turn into pressure.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine first touch, controlled carrying and an accurate final pass.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a three-part circuit: receiving gate, dribbling zone and final passing target.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Receive from the server, dribble through the zone and deliver a weighted pass through the final gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a passive defender; weaker foot final pass; change the passing distance.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: First touch into the route, head up before the final action and pass with appropriate weight.
ejercicios.consejo: The final pass reveals whether the player stayed in control throughout the dribble.

ejercicios.objetivo: Review first touch, close control, turning, protection and final action in one circuit.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create stations for an aerial control, tight slalom, pressure turn, acceleration and final pass or finish.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players move through the complete route in small groups. Quality is scored at each station, not only the total time.
ejercicios.variantes: Team relay; weaker-foot round; add passive defenders; reverse the route.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Prepare before every contact, keep the ball playable and connect each technique smoothly to the next.
ejercicios.consejo: Use this session as an assessment. Record the weakest station and revisit it in future training.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve close ball carrying and the ability to change direction under control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 15 x 15 m area with several cone gates facing different directions. Every player starts with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players carry freely. On the coach's signal, they turn through the nearest gate and accelerate into new space.
ejercicios.variantes: Call a specific turn; use the weaker foot only; add a second signal for an immediate stop.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the ball within playing distance, lower the centre of gravity and look up between touches.
ejercicios.consejo: Quality comes first. Increase speed only when the ball stays under control.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop controlled slalom dribbling followed by an explosive exit.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build two slalom lanes with six cones and a mini-goal 8 m beyond the final cone.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players weave through the cones at controlled speed, then push the ball forward and accelerate to finish in the mini-goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Change cone spacing; time the final sprint; require one round with each foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use small touches in the slalom and a longer touch into space after the final cone.
ejercicios.consejo: The change from control to acceleration is the key coaching moment.

ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate inside and outside touches to move the ball smoothly at speed.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 12 m lanes with markers every 2 m. Players work in pairs, one active and one recovering.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player alternates inside and outside touches with the same foot through the lane, then returns using the other foot.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a finish; reduce the distance between markers; turn it into a relay.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Relax the ankle, keep the knees bent and touch the ball with a consistent rhythm.
ejercicios.consejo: Encourage both feet even when the stronger side feels more natural.

ejercicios.objetivo: Build confidence and control when carrying with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set four small gates around a 14 x 14 m square. Each player has a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players move from gate to gate using only the weaker foot and perform a turn before changing direction.
ejercicios.variantes: Use outside touches only; add a time target; finish with a pass through the final gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take frequent touches, keep the standing foot balanced and avoid reaching too far for the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not accept a switch to the stronger foot when the task becomes difficult.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve a sharp cut followed by immediate acceleration away from pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a pole 8 m from the start and an exit gate 5 m to either side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players attack the pole, cut the ball across the body and accelerate through the gate called by the coach.
ejercicios.variantes: Use inside cut, outside cut or sole drag; add a passive defender at the pole.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Sell the first direction, plant the outside foot and take the exit touch into space.
ejercicios.consejo: A turn beats an opponent only when the player accelerates after it.

ejercicios.objetivo: Teach players to use body movement to unbalance an opponent before dribbling away.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a cone as the defender and place two exit gates 4 m beyond it.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players approach under control, exaggerate a shoulder and hip feint, then push the ball through the opposite gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a double feint; use a passive defender; require a weaker-foot exit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Approach directly, slow slightly before the feint and move the ball only after the defender reacts.
ejercicios.consejo: The body should lie before the ball moves.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve forward carrying while protecting the ball inside a narrow space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two channels 15 x 3 m. Place one attacker at the start and a passive defender halfway.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker carries forward, changes line around the defender and exits at speed through the end gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Narrow the channel; make the defender active; score by reaching the end line in control.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the ball on the safe side, use the body as a shield and attack the free shoulder.
ejercicios.consejo: A narrow channel teaches players to protect the ball without stopping forward progress.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop rapid changes of tempo while maintaining close control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a large square with coloured corner gates. Every player carries a ball inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players move at a steady pace. On the signal, they accelerate toward the colour called, then slow down under control.
ejercicios.variantes: Use visual signals; add a turn before the sprint; require different dribbling surfaces.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use short touches before the signal, a longer first acceleration touch and quick recovery touches near the gate.
ejercicios.consejo: Players should control the tempo, not let the ball control them.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve sole control, lateral movement and quick changes of direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 10 m lanes with a cone at each end. One player works in each lane.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players roll the ball across the body with the sole, step around it and continue forward using alternating feet.
ejercicios.variantes: Move sideways; add a pull-push action; finish with a 5 m acceleration.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay on the toes, keep the ball close to the body and use the sole gently rather than standing on the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: Sole work should stay fluid and connected to the next movement.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine ball protection with a decisive dribble out of pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Work in 8 x 8 m squares with an attacker, passive defender and two exit gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives with the defender close, protects for three seconds, then turns and exits through either gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Make the defender active; limit the attacker to five seconds; add a target pass after the exit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the arm legally, place the body between ball and defender and turn toward the defender's blind side.
ejercicios.consejo: Protection is useful only when it creates the next action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop fast footwork and close dribbling in a restricted lane.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set eight markers 1 m apart in two parallel slalom lanes.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble through with rapid touches, exit over 5 m and join the opposite line.
ejercicios.variantes: Time each run; alternate feet at every marker; finish with a turn and return.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay low, use both feet and avoid hitting the ball beyond the next marker.
ejercicios.consejo: Reduce the spacing only when players can keep a clean rhythm.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect a dribble action with an accurate final pass.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a slalom ending 12 m from two passing gates. A target player stands beyond the gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player dribbles through, lifts the head, selects the free gate and passes firmly to the target.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a passive defender; use the weaker foot; award points for pass accuracy.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Finish the dribble under control, scan before the last touch and pass with a balanced body position.
ejercicios.consejo: The final pass should confirm that the dribble created an advantage.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve scanning and awareness while carrying the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Scatter coloured cones inside a 16 x 16 m square. The coach stands outside with coloured bibs.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players carry freely and call out the colour shown by the coach without losing control of the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Add traffic; call a gate to exit through; ask players to count raised fingers.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take information between touches, keep the ball slightly to the side and avoid staring down for long periods.
ejercicios.consejo: Scanning must become part of the dribbling rhythm, not a separate action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Teach the attacker to engage a defender before changing direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 10 x 8 m area with two scoring gates on the end line. Start one attacker against one defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker drives toward the defender, commits them to one side and exits through the opposite gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Give the defender a delayed start; add a finish; limit the attack to eight seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attack at speed, get close enough to fix the defender and explode after the move.
ejercicios.consejo: Too early gives the defender time to recover; too late closes the space.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve repeated direction changes while keeping forward momentum.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place cones in a wide zigzag pattern over 20 m with 3 to 4 m between points.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players attack each cone, change direction with the outside or inside of the foot and accelerate to the next.
ejercicios.variantes: Use one foot only; reduce the angles; finish with a pass or shot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Approach under control, plant the support foot close to the ball and leave each turn with a positive touch.
ejercicios.consejo: Every change of direction should include a visible change of speed.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use dribbling to escape a defender and leave a pressured zone.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark an 8 x 8 m square with two exit gates and a mini-goal beyond each gate.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker starts inside with a defender. Score by dribbling out through a gate and finishing in the mini-goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Rotate roles after every attack; give the attacker a two-second advantage; narrow the gates.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Protect first if needed, identify the open exit and accelerate immediately once the defender is beaten.
ejercicios.consejo: Reward brave decisions, not only successful outcomes.

ejercicios.objetivo: Help players recognise and attack free space with the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a central square with four numbered exit gates leading into open channels.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players receive in the middle, scan and carry at speed through the gate called just before the pass arrives.
ejercicios.variantes: Call the gate later; add a passive defender; allow the receiver to choose the best exit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Open the body, take the first touch toward space and lengthen the stride once the route is clear.
ejercicios.consejo: Good ball carrying begins with recognising where the space is.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop a quick double touch to shift the ball around an opponent.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a pole defender 7 m from the start and an exit cone 6 m beyond it.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players approach, touch the ball across the body and immediately push it forward with the opposite foot.
ejercicios.variantes: Perform inside-inside or outside-inside; add a passive defender; finish with a shot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep both touches quick, move the body with the ball and accelerate off the second contact.
ejercicios.consejo: The two touches should feel like one continuous action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve close control, turns and awareness in a crowded area.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 10 x 10 m square. Every player has a ball and moves continuously.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players avoid one another while performing a turn whenever they reach a line or hear the signal.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce the square; remove two balls and add pass exchanges; make it a last-player-in challenge.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use small touches, protect the ball from traffic and scan before changing direction.
ejercicios.consejo: Crowding should create decisions, not collisions.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve balance and foot speed before a sharp dribbling action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create stations with two quick footwork markers followed by a ball and two exit gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players complete the footwork, collect the ball and cut quickly through the gate called by the coach.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the footwork pattern; add a passive defender; finish with a pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay light on the feet, stabilise before touching the ball and push off strongly after the cut.
ejercicios.consejo: Fast feet matter only when the first ball contact stays clean.

ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain ball control while an opponent applies realistic pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set 12 x 5 m channels. One attacker carries while a defender follows at arm's length.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker protects the ball, changes line and tries to reach the end gate without losing control.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow shoulder pressure; make the defender active after halfway; switch sides.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the far foot, keep the body between defender and ball and avoid straight-line dribbling.
ejercicios.consejo: Passive pressure should still force realistic body positioning.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine beating an obstacle with a composed finish from close range.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a slalom or passive defender 10 m from a mini-goal. Start players with a ball 8 m away.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble past the obstacle and finish before crossing a marked line.
ejercicios.variantes: Use the weaker foot; make the defender active; add a goalkeeper in a larger goal.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Lift the head after the final dribble touch, shorten the steps and finish with balance.
ejercicios.consejo: The last dribble touch should prepare the shot, not force an extra adjustment.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link several dribbling techniques in one progressive circuit.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build four stations: close slalom, sole turn, body feint and acceleration to a mini-goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players move through every station, resting briefly after each full circuit.
ejercicios.variantes: Score technical quality; add a timed round; reverse the direction.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep technique clean at every station and use the correct touch size for the available space.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not let competition turn the circuit into uncontrolled running.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a convincing feint to move the defender before changing side.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a central cone defender with two gates 4 m apart beyond it.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players approach, feint toward one gate and take the ball sharply through the other.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a passive defender; call the exit late; use a double feint.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move shoulders and eyes toward the false side, then push the ball across with the opposite foot.
ejercicios.consejo: The feint must be believable before the direction changes.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop the ability to carry at speed without losing control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 30 m lane with control zones every 10 m and a turning gate at the end.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players accelerate through the first zone, reduce the touch size in the middle and accelerate again after the turn.
ejercicios.variantes: Time the run; use the weaker foot in the middle zone; add a final pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Push the ball farther in open space, shorten touches near the turn and keep the head up.
ejercicios.consejo: Efficient carrying changes touch size as the available space changes.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve decision-making and direction changes in an attacking 1v1.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 10 x 10 m area with two scoring gates on the defender's end line.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives from the coach and scores by dribbling through either gate under control.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the starting angle; narrow one gate; add a counter-gate for the defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan both gates, commit the defender and attack the open side with a clear acceleration.
ejercicios.consejo: Two gates prevent predictable dribbling and reward scanning.

ejercicios.objetivo: Rehearse dribbling moves against a realistic opponent before full pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Work in 12 m channels. A defender starts centrally and moves at half speed.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker approaches, performs a chosen move and exits beyond the defender with control.
ejercicios.variantes: Increase defender speed; require a specific move; add a finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Approach close enough to engage the defender and accelerate immediately after the move.
ejercicios.consejo: Passive defenders must provide a realistic picture, not stand still like cones.

ejercicios.objetivo: Protect the ball while continuing to move forward or sideways.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 15 x 5 m channels. Pair an attacker with a defender applying side pressure.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker carries toward the end while using the body and far foot to keep possession.
ejercicios.variantes: Swap the pressure side; add an exit gate; allow the defender to become active near the end.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Bend the knees, extend the arm for balance and keep the ball on the foot farthest from pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: Protection should preserve movement rather than stop the action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Escape a crowded area by using a turn, feint or acceleration.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark an 8 x 8 m box with three exit gates. Use one attacker and one defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives inside, protects if necessary and dribbles out through any available gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a second defender; limit the time; place a target player beyond each gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before receiving, keep the body between defender and ball and choose the first clear exit.
ejercicios.consejo: Escaping pressure is a decision skill as much as a technical skill.

ejercicios.objetivo: Adapt touch size and direction while moving through varied obstacles.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a course with wide gates, a tight slalom, a low obstacle to go around and a final sprint lane.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players complete the route with the ball, changing dribbling technique for each section.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse the route; use the weaker foot; finish with a pass or shot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Look ahead, prepare the next section early and avoid using the same touch size everywhere.
ejercicios.consejo: The course should teach adaptation, not simply memorisation.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve close control, awareness and movement through crowded spaces.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 14 x 14 m area with most players carrying a ball and several passive blockers without balls.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Ball carriers move continuously, change direction to avoid traffic and exit through a gate on the signal.
ejercicios.variantes: Make blockers active; reduce the area; add colour-coded exits.
