ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan early, use the outside foot to move away from traffic and protect the ball when space closes.
ejercicios.consejo: Players should learn to see pressure before it reaches them.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link off-the-ball movement, first touch and forward ball carrying.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a passer, receiver and two forward gates in a 15 x 12 m area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks away, comes toward the pass, opens the body and carries through one of the forward gates.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a passive defender; vary the pass angle; finish with a target pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create separation before receiving, scan over the shoulder and take the first touch into the selected route.
ejercicios.consejo: The dribble starts before the ball arrives, with the player's movement and scanning.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve diagonal carrying that moves the ball across defensive lines.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set two diagonal lanes crossing a central square, with start and finish gates at opposite corners.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players carry diagonally, adjust around traffic in the centre and accelerate through the far gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a pass before the carry; use the weaker foot; introduce a passive defender in the centre.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the inside foot to protect from central pressure and keep the body open to both sides.
ejercicios.consejo: Diagonal carries can open new passing angles as well as gain distance.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use an outside-foot cut to create shooting space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a cone or passive defender 12 m from goal. Players start 6 m farther back with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Attack the defender, cut outside, take one preparation touch and shoot.
ejercicios.variantes: Cut inside on the next round; add a live defender; finish with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Sell the central route, take the cut across the defender's line and shoot before recovery.
ejercicios.consejo: The cut must create a clear shooting lane, not just move the ball sideways.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive with the back to play, turn and accelerate into space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a passer, receiver and passive defender in a 12 x 10 m area with two forward gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks to the ball, protects, performs a half-turn and dribbles through the free gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Make the defender active; require a sole turn; add a final pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Feel the defender, keep the ball close on the turn and accelerate as soon as the hips face forward.
ejercicios.consejo: The first step after the turn must create separation.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve high-speed ball carrying while preserving technical control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two parallel 25 m courses with one turn and a controlled finish box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players race against the clock, but the run counts only if the ball stops inside the finish box.
ejercicios.variantes: Team relay; weaker-foot round; add two direction changes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use longer touches in open sections, shorten before the turn and regain control before the finish.
ejercicios.consejo: A fast time without control is not a successful repetition.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Commit Then Play the Final Pass
ejercicios.objetivo: Draw a defender toward the ball before releasing a teammate with a pass.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 2v1 channel with the ball carrier central and a support player wide.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker drives at the defender, waits for commitment and passes through the open lane to the support player.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow the carrier to dribble if the defender stays; finish in a mini-goal; swap sides.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Carry directly at the defender, keep the support player wide and release the pass at the last useful moment.
ejercicios.consejo: The purpose of the dribble is sometimes to free a teammate, not beat the defender personally.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a neutral support player to create new dribbling and combination options.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 12 x 10 m area with a mini-goal at each end and a neutral player on one side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker can combine once with the neutral player or dribble directly to score. The defender counterattacks on recovery.
ejercicios.variantes: Neutral player one touch; move the neutral to an end line; rotate every two minutes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the neutral to change the defender's angle, then attack the new space aggressively.
ejercicios.consejo: Support should create a better 1v1, not remove the need to attack.

ejercicios.objetivo: Carry the ball across zones while adapting speed and direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Divide a 24 x 16 m area into three horizontal zones with two gates between each zone.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players carry from one end to the other, selecting a gate and changing pace every time they enter a new zone.
ejercicios.variantes: Add defenders in the middle zone; call a colour gate; finish with a pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before crossing a line, attack the open gate and reduce touch size when entering pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: Changing zones should trigger a new scan and a new decision.

ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain possession and find an exit in a very small area.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 7 x 7 m square with two attackers and one defender. One attacker begins with the ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball carrier protects, turns and attempts to dribble through one of two corner gates.
ejercicios.variantes: Play 1v1; limit time to six seconds; add a support player outside.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use quick sole and outside touches, keep the body compact and change direction before the defender sets.
ejercicios.consejo: Small spaces reward early decisions and precise touches.

ejercicios.objetivo: Attack open space quickly and finish under control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a start line 20 m from two mini-goals. Place a turning cone halfway.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players carry at speed, choose either side of the cone and finish in the opposite mini-goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a chasing defender; use the weaker foot; set a time limit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Push the ball into running distance, take a shorter final touch and pass accurately into the goal.
ejercicios.consejo: Speed creates the chance; control finishes it.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Shot Feint and Beat the Defender
ejercicios.objetivo: Use a shot feint to freeze a defender and create a route to goal.
ejercicios.organizacion: Start 15 m from goal with one attacker and one passive defender between ball and target.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker shapes to shoot, takes the ball around the defender and finishes quickly.
ejercicios.variantes: Make the defender active; alternate exit sides; award extra points for weaker-foot finishes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Show a convincing backswing, keep the ball close after the feint and accelerate past the defender's front foot.
ejercicios.consejo: The feint works when the defender believes the shot is coming.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use the touchline as a reference while protecting the ball from inside pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 20 x 4 m wide channel along the touchline with an attacker and a defender inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker carries down the line, protects from the defender and can cut inside through a bonus gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Make the defender active; add a cross at the end; reverse sides.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the ball on the outside foot when possible, use the arm for balance and recognise when to cut inside.
ejercicios.consejo: The line can protect one side, but it also reduces escape options.

ejercicios.objetivo: Secure the ball with the back to pressure, then turn into free space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Work in 8 x 8 m squares with a passer, receiver and defender behind the receiver.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver holds the ball for two seconds, then chooses a turn and dribbles through one of two gates.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch set before turning; active defender; finish with a target pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use a wide stance, feel the defender without leaning and keep the ball on the safe foot.
ejercicios.consejo: Protection should buy information and time for a decisive turn.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect controlled approach, a clear feint and explosive acceleration.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create 18 m lanes with a pole defender at 8 m and an exit gate 6 m beyond.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players carry toward the pole, perform any approved feint and sprint through the gate with the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Coach calls the move; add a passive defender; finish with a pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Approach under control, exaggerate the feint and make the first exit touch positive.
ejercicios.consejo: The acceleration after the move is often what actually beats the opponent.

ejercicios.objetivo: Enter a 1v1 at speed after carrying through open space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 12 m approach lane leading into a 10 x 8 m duel area with two mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker carries through the lane. As they enter the duel area, a defender steps out to engage.
ejercicios.variantes: Give the defender a delayed start; change the attack angle; add a counter-goal.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Control the entry touch, read the defender's body shape and attack before they become balanced.
ejercicios.consejo: A defender is easiest to beat while still moving into position.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve scanning and late decision-making during a dribble.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place four coloured gates around a central 12 x 12 m square. Players start from the middle with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The coach shows a colour late. Players change direction and escape through the matching gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Use two colours in sequence; add a passive defender; let players choose based on defender position.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep touches short before the decision, turn efficiently and accelerate immediately after choosing.
ejercicios.consejo: Late information forces players to stay adaptable rather than pre-plan the whole action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine close control, changes of direction, pressure escape and finishing.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a multi-part circuit: tight slalom, body feint, protected turn, speed carry and mini-goal finish.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players complete the full route in sequence and recover while the next player starts.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a passive defender; score each section; run a team relay after technical practice.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Adjust touch size to every section, scan before each decision and finish each move with acceleration.
ejercicios.consejo: A complete circuit should still preserve the coaching detail of each action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Assess the module through a competitive challenge combining technique and decision-making.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create five stations: weaker-foot carry, timed slalom, feint gate, pressure escape and 1v1 finish.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players collect points at each station. Finish with short 1v1 games where bonus points reward successful dribbles.
ejercicios.variantes: Run individual or team scoring; adjust distances by age; allow one repeat at the weakest station.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Reward control, scanning, correct choice and acceleration, not speed alone.
ejercicios.consejo: Use the results to identify the next technical priority for each player.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve shooting technique and accuracy after carrying the ball into range.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a starting line 20 m from goal and a shooting line 12 to 15 m from goal. Players begin with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player dribbles forward, prepares the ball with the final touch and shoots before crossing the shooting line.
ejercicios.variantes: Finish with the weaker foot; add a passive defender; award points for hitting selected zones.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Lift the head before the final touch, place the standing foot beside the ball and strike through the target.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not turn the drill into a power contest. A controlled, accurate shot is the priority.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop timing and finishing from a pass pulled back from the end line.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set one server near the byline and a finishing line near the edge of the penalty area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The server drives toward the end line and cuts the ball back. The finisher delays the run, arrives into space and shoots.
ejercicios.variantes: Alternate sides; one-touch finish; add a recovering defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Arrive rather than wait, stay behind the ball and choose the finish before contact.
ejercicios.consejo: The quality of the run is as important as the strike. Late movement creates a clear shooting lane.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve placement by targeting defined scoring zones.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark four target zones inside the goal with cones, poles or small goals. Start players 14 to 18 m out.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players receive a short pass, take one preparation touch and shoot toward the zone called by the coach.
ejercicios.variantes: Use a points system; alternate feet; call the target late.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: See the target early, keep the ankle firm and prioritise a clean contact over maximum power.
ejercicios.consejo: Reward deliberate placement. Players should know where they are shooting before the backswing begins.

ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate crossing runs and finishing from central areas.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set two starting cones outside the box and one server centrally. Two attackers begin on opposite sides.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Both attackers make crossed runs. The server passes into the path of one runner, who finishes quickly.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the service angle; add a passive defender; use a low or lifted pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Time the run to stay onside, avoid colliding with the other attacker and finish without unnecessary touches.
ejercicios.consejo: Demand clear communication before the runners cross. Movement must create space, not congestion.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use an open first touch to create a direct route to goal.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a receiving player between two poles 16 to 20 m from goal. A server stands at an angle behind the player.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The receiver checks away, comes toward the pass, opens the body and takes the first touch into the shooting lane.
ejercicios.variantes: Call the exit side late; add a passive defender; finish with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before receiving, receive on the back foot and make the first touch decisive but controlled.
ejercicios.consejo: The first touch should remove a defender and prepare the shot at the same time.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve first-time finishing from a moving pass.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use two serving positions 10 to 14 m from goal and a finishing cone in the centre.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The server passes across the finisher, who adjusts the feet and shoots with one touch.
ejercicios.variantes: Alternate feet; vary pass speed; add a goalkeeper or target zones.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take small adjustment steps, lock the ankle and guide the ball rather than swinging excessively.
ejercicios.consejo: The player must move to the ball. Waiting flat-footed usually produces a poor contact.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect close dribbling, acceleration and a composed finish.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a short slalom ending 12 m from goal or two mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble through the cones, accelerate after the final cone and finish with a maximum of two touches.
ejercicios.variantes: Use the weaker foot; add a passive defender after the slalom; time the action.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep touches small in the slalom, make the exit touch positive and regain balance before shooting.
ejercicios.consejo: The last dribbling touch should set up the shot, not force an extra correction.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Shot After a Change of Pace
ejercicios.objetivo: Create shooting space through a clear change of speed.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 20 m route with a controlled approach zone and an acceleration zone before goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker carries at medium speed, changes pace on the signal and shoots after entering the final zone.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a chasing defender; call the acceleration direction; alternate feet.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use a longer touch into open space, shorten the final steps and strike before the defender recovers.
ejercicios.consejo: The change of pace should be visible. A constant speed rarely creates separation.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve finishing after a simple lay-off from a support player.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a support player centrally 16 m from goal and a shooter 6 to 8 m behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The shooter passes into the support, continues the run and shoots the lay-off with one or two touches.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch lay-off; finish with the weaker foot; add a passive defender behind the support.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Play the first pass firmly, continue the run at an angle and ask for the lay-off into the shooting foot.
ejercicios.consejo: The support player should set the ball into space, not back underneath the runner.

ejercicios.objetivo: Build confidence and accuracy when finishing with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two identical shooting stations from comfortable central angles.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players receive or dribble into the area and must finish only with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.variantes: Start closer to goal; progress to moving passes; add target zones.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the approach balanced, use a firm ankle and accept lower power while technical quality develops.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not allow players to avoid the task by shifting the ball back onto the stronger foot.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve decision-making and composure in a direct scoring duel.
ejercicios.organizacion: Start the attacker 20 m from goal with the goalkeeper in position. Use a service from the side or centre.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives, drives toward goal and decides whether to shoot early, go around the goalkeeper or finish after a touch.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a recovering defender; limit the time; vary the starting angle.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Observe the goalkeeper, keep the ball within striking distance and commit to the chosen action.
ejercicios.consejo: Encourage different solutions. The correct finish depends on the goalkeeper, not on a fixed pattern.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve movement and finishing from wide deliveries.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set one crosser on each side and two finishing positions inside the box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The crosser delivers after a short dribble. Attackers time runs to the near post, central zone and far post.
ejercicios.variantes: Low cross; cutback; aerial service; add one passive defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attack different spaces, arrive at speed and adjust the body to the flight and height of the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: Rotate roles often so every player learns both the service and the finishing movement.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Finish After a Run in Behind
ejercicios.objetivo: Develop timing and finishing after penetrating beyond a defensive line.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark an offside line with cones. A passer starts centrally and the attacker begins level with the line.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker checks short, spins in behind and receives a through pass before finishing.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the pass angle; add a passive defender; require a one-touch finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Delay the run, accelerate after the passer looks up and take the first touch away from recovering pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: The run should begin from information, not from guessing. Encourage eye contact with the passer.

ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain shooting technique while a defender applies realistic pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 15 x 8 m channel toward goal. An attacker starts with a defender one step behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives forward and shoots before the defender can block. The defender applies pressure without tackling at first.
ejercicios.variantes: Make the defender active; start side by side; limit touches.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Protect the ball with the body, shorten the backlift and finish quickly when the lane opens.
ejercicios.consejo: Passive pressure must still be realistic enough to affect the attacker's timing and body position.

ejercicios.objetivo: Reduce the time between receiving and finishing.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set servers at different angles around a shooting zone 14 to 18 m from goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The coach calls a server. The attacker receives, controls into space and shoots within two touches.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch finish; late directional call; add a passive blocker.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before the ball arrives, use the first touch to escape pressure and keep the shooting action compact.
ejercicios.consejo: Measure speed without sacrificing accuracy. A rushed miss is not a successful repetition.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine a wall pass with a well-timed finish.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a support player near the edge of the box and a starting line 10 m behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker passes into the support, runs beyond and finishes the return pass.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch return; add a defender; switch the support angle.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Pass firmly, accelerate immediately after the pass and ask for the return in front of the run.
ejercicios.consejo: The speed of the run after the first pass creates the shooting opportunity.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve passing-style finishing and accuracy into small targets.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place two mini-goals at different angles 10 to 14 m from the shooting line.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players receive from a server and finish into the goal indicated by a colour or signal.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch; weak foot; narrow the goals; add a passive defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the head still, use the inside of the foot when appropriate and pass the ball accurately into the target.
ejercicios.consejo: Small targets teach precision. Do not encourage unnecessary power.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a convincing feint to create room for a shot.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a pole or passive defender 14 m from goal. Attackers start 6 m farther back.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker drives forward, performs a shot feint or body feint, moves the ball into space and finishes.
ejercicios.variantes: Make the defender active; alternate exit sides; finish with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Sell the first action with the body, keep the ball close after the feint and shoot before recovery.
ejercicios.consejo: The feint must affect the defender. Decorative movements without a change of direction add no value.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop solutions when shooting space is limited near the side of goal.
ejercicios.organizacion: Start attackers near the corner of the penalty area with a narrow route toward goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble or receive into the channel and finish from the tight angle.
ejercicios.variantes: Near-post target; cut inside before shooting; add a goalkeeper.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Look at the goalkeeper, keep the ball close and choose between the near post, far post or a lifted finish.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not force the same solution every time. The goalkeeper's position changes the best option.

ejercicios.objetivo: Finish efficiently after receiving a diagonal pass across the body.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a passer on one side and a runner arriving from the opposite channel.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The passer plays diagonally into the runner, who controls forward or shoots first time.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse sides; add a passive defender; use a lofted diagonal pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Open the hips, meet the ball on the move and prepare the shot with the first contact.
ejercicios.consejo: A diagonal pass gives the receiver a wide view of goal. Use that advantage before the defender recovers.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve finishing from bouncing, lifted or dropping balls.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use servers 8 to 12 m from a central finishing player. Keep the service controlled and repeatable.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The server clips or throws the ball into the finishing area. The attacker volleys, half-volleys or controls before shooting.
ejercicios.variantes: Alternate feet; vary height; add a goalkeeper; finish with the head for older groups.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Track the ball early, adjust with small steps and attack the centre of the ball with a stable body.
ejercicios.consejo: Begin with easy service. The technical challenge should rise only when contacts remain safe and clean.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve fast reactions and varied finishes in crowded scoring areas.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a central box inside the penalty area. Use two servers, two attackers and one passive defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Servers play different balls into the box. Attackers react, combine if needed and finish quickly.
ejercicios.variantes: Add active defenders; two-touch limit; score from rebounds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay alive for second balls, create separation with short movements and finish with minimal backlift.
ejercicios.consejo: Inside the box, speed of thought matters more than long preparation.

ejercicios.objetivo: Attack goal quickly immediately after possession changes.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two adjacent areas with a target goal at one end. Start with a small possession game.
ejercicios.desarrollo: When the defending team wins the ball, it breaks out and tries to finish within eight seconds.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a second goal; limit passes; start with numerical advantage.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: First pass forward when possible, sprint to support and shoot before the defence reorganises.
ejercicios.consejo: The transition begins on the regain. Players who react late lose the best shooting moment.

ejercicios.objetivo: Convert a ball recovery into an immediate scoring attempt.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 15 x 12 m area with one attacker, one defender and a target goal beyond the area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The defender begins in possession. The attacker presses, regains the ball and finishes as quickly as possible.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a support player; use two goals; time the finish after the regain.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Press from an angle, secure the first touch after winning and recognise whether to shoot immediately or carry.
ejercicios.consejo: Winning the ball is only half the action. The next touch should already prepare the finish.

ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate three quick actions around the edge of the box.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a passer, a central target player and a runner positioned behind the ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The passer plays into the target, who sets the ball into the runner's path for a shot.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch set; add a passive defender; rotate the target after every action.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Target player checks the shoulder, sets at an angle and keeps the ball moving away from pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: The set must invite the shot. A square or backward lay-off slows the action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Strike accurately while moving at speed.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create diagonal running lanes ending 14 to 18 m from goal. A server passes into each lane.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker accelerates onto the pass and shoots without stopping the run.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch finish; chase from behind; alternate sides.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Match the stride to the ball, shorten the final step and keep the chest controlled through contact.
ejercicios.consejo: Players should not reach for the ball. Adjust the run so the contact arrives naturally.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine a positive dribble with a calm placed finish.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a central cone or mannequin 15 m from goal with two routes around it.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player dribbles past the obstacle, looks at the goalkeeper and passes the ball into a selected corner.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a passive defender; weak foot; score points for zones.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Slow the final action, open the foot and guide the ball with controlled pace.
ejercicios.consejo: After beating an opponent, players often rush. Demand composure in the final contact.

ejercicios.objetivo: Attack the correct space and finish a fast low delivery.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a crosser wide and attackers at the near-post, penalty-spot and far-post starting positions.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The crosser drives the ball across goal. Attackers time runs to different finishing zones.
ejercicios.variantes: Cutback variation; add defenders; alternate sides.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay out of the finishing lane until the ball is played, arrive with speed and adjust the foot surface to the pass.
ejercicios.consejo: Low crosses reward timing. Early runs allow defenders to recover and block the space.

ejercicios.objetivo: Make a quick but controlled finishing decision.
ejercicios.organizacion: Start the attacker 18 m from goal with a ball or service. Mark a five-second finishing window.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the signal, the player attacks the goal and must shoot before time expires.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce the time; add a recovering defender; use two starting angles.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take information early, avoid extra touches and keep the technique compact under pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: Time pressure should simplify decisions, not create panic. Reward fast, clear solutions.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a check away and check back to lose a marker before finishing.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a pole or passive defender between the attacker and server. Mark a short and a deep receiving zone.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker moves away, changes direction sharply, receives in the opposite space and finishes.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse the sequence; add an active defender; one-touch finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Change speed at the turn, create a clear passing lane and arrive side-on to goal.
ejercicios.consejo: The second movement must be explosive. A slow return allows the defender to stay connected.

ejercicios.objetivo: Choose between an across-goal finish and a near-post strike.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two shooting lanes from the left and right side of the box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players receive in the channel, look at the goalkeeper and finish toward the correct side.
ejercicios.variantes: Coach calls near or far late; add passive pressure; use the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Open the body for the far corner, close the ankle for the near post and avoid telegraphing the shot.
ejercicios.consejo: Teach players to read the goalkeeper rather than memorise one finish from each angle.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive with the back to goal, protect the ball and create a shooting action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a target player 14 m from goal with a defender behind and a server in front.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The target receives, protects, turns to either side and shoots.
ejercicios.variantes: Passive then active defender; set to a third player; use a two-touch limit after the turn.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the body to feel pressure, keep the ball on the safe side and turn through the defender's blind side.
ejercicios.consejo: The turn should be based on information. Encourage a shoulder check before the pass arrives.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive between lines, half-turn and finish in one fluid action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a passer behind the attacker and two forward gates around a central pole.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker scans, receives on the back foot, half-turns through the free gate and shoots.
ejercicios.variantes: Call the gate late; add a passive defender; finish with the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Open the hips before contact, use the first touch to face goal and accelerate into the strike.
ejercicios.consejo: The half-turn begins before the pass through scanning and body preparation.

ejercicios.objetivo: Move the ball sideways to open a clear shooting lane.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a mannequin or defender between the attacker and goal 16 m out.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives, shifts the ball across the obstacle and shoots through the new angle.
ejercicios.variantes: Shift left or right; add active pressure; one-touch set from a teammate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move the ball beyond the blocking line, reposition the standing foot and shoot before the lane closes.
ejercicios.consejo: A small lateral touch can create a large visual change. Do not over-dribble once the lane opens.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use numerical advantage to create a high-quality shooting chance.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 3v2 or 4v3 attack toward goal in a 30 x 25 m area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Attackers combine to create a free player and must finish before the defenders recover their shape.
ejercicios.variantes: Limit passes; add a recovering defender; bonus for a first-time finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep width, commit one defender before passing and attack the box after releasing the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: The overload should create a better shot, not endless passing. Encourage the first clear chance.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive a forward pass between lines and finish quickly.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a passer 25 m from goal, a receiver at the edge of the box and poles representing a defensive line.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The passer plays vertically into the receiver, who controls across the body and shoots.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch set and return; add a defender; use a bouncing pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Show in a clear lane, receive side-on and protect the first touch from pressure behind.
ejercicios.consejo: Vertical play must stay connected. The passer should support in case the direct shot is blocked.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve movement and contact at the far post.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a wide server and place the finisher on the opposite side of the box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The server crosses low or aerially. The finisher delays, then attacks the far-post space.
ejercicios.variantes: Alternate sides; add one defender; finish first time or after one touch.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay outside the defender's line of sight, arrive as the ball travels and keep the contact directed back across goal.
ejercicios.consejo: Far-post players must remain active even when the ball starts on the opposite side.

ejercicios.objetivo: Beat an opponent and finish before defensive recovery.
ejercicios.organizacion: Start an attacker and defender 18 m from goal with the attacker in possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker has eight seconds to beat the defender and shoot. The defender counterattacks if possession changes.
ejercicios.variantes: Give the attacker a head start; use two mini-goals; add a goalkeeper.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Commit the defender, accelerate after the move and prepare the shot with the exit touch.
ejercicios.consejo: The dribble and finish are one action. A poor exit touch usually removes the shooting chance.

ejercicios.objetivo: Drive toward pressure to open space before finishing or combining.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 2v1 attack toward goal with one ball carrier and one wide support player.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The carrier attacks the defender. If the defender blocks the shot, the carrier passes wide and continues for the return.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow a direct dribble; add a second defender; limit the action to six seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Carry directly at the defender, keep the support wide and make the final decision late but clearly.
ejercicios.consejo: Committing a defender creates the advantage. Passing too early gives the defender time to recover.

ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate a forward pass, supporting run and finish.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set three stations in a diagonal pattern leading toward goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Player A passes to B and runs forward. B sets or passes into the run, and A finishes.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a third player; one-touch passing; switch direction.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move immediately after the pass, keep the return pass ahead of the runner and finish without breaking stride.
ejercicios.consejo: The first pass should trigger the run. Players must not admire their pass.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a three-player combination to create a central finish.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place players in wide, central and advanced positions around the edge of the box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball moves wide, inside to a set player and then into the run of the third player for a shot.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse sides; add passive defenders; one-touch final pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Maintain passing angles, time the third-player run and play the final ball into the shooting path.
ejercicios.consejo: The runner should arrive from outside the defender's view, not stand in the final space.

ejercicios.objetivo: Finish quickly after winning the ball near the opponent's goal.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a build-up zone 25 m from goal with defenders in possession and attackers pressing.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Attackers press to regain. Once they win the ball, they have six seconds to shoot.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the numbers; add a neutral player; reward first-pass shots.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Close passing lanes, react to loose touches and secure the first action after the regain.
ejercicios.consejo: A high regain is valuable because the defence is disorganised. Do not slow the moment with unnecessary passes.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control a wide service and finish before pressure arrives.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use one crosser and one finisher. Deliver to the central or far side of the box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The finisher controls the cross into shooting space and finishes with the second touch.
ejercicios.variantes: Aerial or low service; add a recovering defender; weaker-foot finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Read the flight early, cushion the control away from pressure and keep the next action in front of the body.
ejercicios.consejo: The first touch must make the finish easier. A dead touch under the body creates extra work.

ejercicios.objetivo: Apply finishing skills against live defenders in realistic situations.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 2v2 or 3v3 game in a 25 x 20 m area with goalkeepers or mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams attack normally, but every attack must end with a shot within ten seconds.
ejercicios.variantes: Two-touch limit in the final zone; bonus for first-time finishes; add neutral players.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create space before receiving, recognise the shooting window and attack rebounds aggressively.
ejercicios.consejo: Opposition reveals whether technique transfers to the game. Coach decisions as much as execution.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Quick Shot from a Loose Ball
ejercicios.objetivo: React quickly to an unpredictable loose ball or rebound.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place the attacker near the edge of the box. The coach rolls, deflects or tosses balls into different spaces.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker reacts, adjusts and shoots as quickly as possible.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a passive blocker; use rebounds from the goalkeeper; call the finishing foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay on the toes, move the feet before swinging and strike with a short, controlled backlift.
ejercicios.consejo: Loose-ball finishing rewards readiness. Players should expect the ball even when it is not clean.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create and finish chances from the highest-value central area close to goal.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a central scoring zone between the six-yard box and penalty spot. Use wide servers and central attackers.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Attackers must enter the zone at the correct moment and finish crosses, cutbacks or rebounds.
ejercicios.variantes: Add defenders; one-touch bonus; alternate service types.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Arrive between defenders, attack the ball first and keep the finish simple from close range.
ejercicios.consejo: Movement into the danger zone should be explosive and timed, not static.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop accuracy through a competitive but technically controlled challenge.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create several shooting stations with different angles and point values.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams rotate through the stations. Each player receives one attempt per station before the next teammate goes.
ejercicios.variantes: Weak-foot round; moving pass round; pressure shot to finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep a consistent routine, select a target and value clean technique over rushed attempts.
ejercicios.consejo: Competition should increase focus. Stop the challenge if technique becomes careless.

ejercicios.objetivo: Review several finishing actions in one organised circuit.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build four stations: dribble and shoot, one-two finish, low cross and aerial control finish.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Groups spend three to four minutes at each station before rotating.
ejercicios.variantes: Score accuracy; add passive pressure; finish with a live 2v1 station.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Maintain intensity, rotate quickly and preserve the key technical detail at every station.
ejercicios.consejo: A circuit should provide repetition without long waiting. Keep groups small and balls ready.

ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain composure and technique after a short high-intensity action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 10-second movement task before a receiving and finishing station.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player completes quick shuttles or changes of direction, then immediately receives and shoots.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the physical task; add passive pressure; use a scoring target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Control breathing, shorten the final steps and avoid leaning back when tired.
ejercicios.consejo: Fatigue should challenge the finish, not destroy technique. Keep work periods short and quality high.

ejercicios.objetivo: Transfer the module's finishing principles into a realistic game.
ejercicios.organizacion: Play 4v4 to 6v6 in a 35 x 25 m area with goalkeepers or mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams score normally, with bonus points for first-time finishes, rebounds, cutbacks or goals after a regain.
ejercicios.variantes: Shot clock; designated finishing zones; neutral wide players.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create width, attack the box after passing and react immediately to second balls.
ejercicios.consejo: Finish the module with the game. Observe which technical habits now appear without direct instruction.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop the ability to unbalance a defender and escape the duel with the ball under control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 12 x 12 m area. Place two target gates or mini-goals behind the defender. Attackers and defenders queue on opposite sides.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives and attacks either gate. The defender protects both targets and counterattacks through the opposite line after winning the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Start the attacker with the back to play; call a gate late; allow one outside neutral pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Approach under control, attack the defender's front foot, use a clear feint and accelerate immediately after beating the opponent.
ejercicios.consejo: The move creates the opening, but the change of pace completes the action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve reaction, scanning and direct 1v1 decision-making from an unpredictable service.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two identical 14 x 10 m areas. The attacker and defender start side by side while the coach stands centrally with balls.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The coach passes into the area. The first player to control attacks a gate; the other immediately becomes the defender.
ejercicios.variantes: Use a bounced pass; serve to either side; set a six-second limit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: React on the flight of the ball, secure the first touch, identify the defender's angle and attack before the opponent becomes balanced.
ejercicios.consejo: An unpredictable service makes the first two steps and the first touch decisive.

ejercicios.objetivo: Learn to protect the ball, create separation and progress when space is restricted.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a 16 x 5 m channel with a mini-goal at one end and a counter gate at the other.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker starts in possession and must beat the defender to score. If the defender wins the ball, the counter gate becomes the target.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce the width; start with a passive defender; allow a wall pass from the coach.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the body between opponent and ball, avoid unnecessary touches and change speed as soon as a forward lane appears.
ejercicios.consejo: In tight spaces, a strong body position can be more effective than an elaborate skill.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop receiving, ball protection and turning against pressure from behind.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place an attacker 14 m from goal with a defender tight behind. A server stands 8 m in front of the attacker.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives to feet, protects the ball and chooses whether to turn, roll the defender or set and spin before finishing.
ejercicios.variantes: Passive then active pressure; limit the turn to five seconds; add a support player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Check the shoulder before receiving, feel the defender through body contact and keep the ball on the safe side.
ejercicios.consejo: The turn should come from information, not hope. Scan before the pass arrives.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve first-step speed, legal shoulder contact and control while competing for a loose ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place two players side by side 12 m from a central ball. Set one mini-goal at each end of the area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the signal, both sprint to the ball. The first player in control attacks one goal while the other defends and can counterattack.
ejercicios.variantes: Start seated or facing away; vary the ball distance; use a curved approach.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Win the running line without pushing, lower the centre of gravity before contact and make the first touch away from pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: Teach players to compete strongly while keeping contact safe, balanced and football-specific.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use the first touch to face forward and create an immediate advantage over the defender.
ejercicios.organizacion: The attacker starts between two coloured gates with the defender two metres behind. A server passes from the side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker scans, opens the body and takes the first touch toward a chosen gate. The defender becomes active as the pass travels.
ejercicios.variantes: Call the colour late; receive on the weaker foot; make the defender start level.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Receive on the back foot, keep the first touch within playing distance and attack before the defender closes the angle.
ejercicios.consejo: A positive first touch can win the duel before a dribbling move is needed.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve defensive delay, body shape and timing when protecting a line.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 12 m line behind the defender. The attacker begins 10 m away with a ball and scores by dribbling across the line.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The defender approaches under control, shows the attacker away from the centre and tackles only when the ball leaves the attacker's feet.
ejercicios.variantes: Add two scoring gates; allow a counterattack; reduce the distance.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Slow the attacker, stay side-on, keep an arm's-length distance and avoid crossing the feet during lateral movement.
ejercicios.consejo: The defender wins first by controlling the attacker's speed and direction, not by diving in.

ejercicios.objetivo: Protect possession under close pressure and turn into free space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 10 x 10 m square with an exit gate on each side. The attacker receives centrally with a defender behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker must protect for two seconds, identify the free gate, turn and escape. The defender scores by winning and controlling the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Increase protection time; call the exit gate late; allow a bounce pass from a neutral player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use a wide base, bend the knees, keep the ball away from the defender and turn when the pressure shifts to one side.
ejercicios.consejo: Protection is active: the player should keep scanning for the moment to escape.

ejercicios.objetivo: Train rapid mental transition from attacking to defending and back again.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set two mini-goals 16 m apart. One attacker starts against one defender while the next pair waits with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: As soon as the action ends, the previous attacker becomes the defender against a new attacker entering immediately.
ejercicios.variantes: Use a time limit; award bonus points for quick regains; reverse the entry side.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Finish the first action, react instantly, recover a central line and avoid switching off after losing or scoring.
ejercicios.consejo: The role change is the exercise. Do not allow players to admire the previous action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Recognise and exploit the space left open by the defender.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place three gates behind a defender in a 15 x 12 m area. The attacker starts centrally with the ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The defender may protect only two gates at once. The attacker scans, commits the defender and exits through the free gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Coach closes one gate with a colour signal; add a recovering defender; require a finish after the gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the head up between touches, move the defender before changing direction and accelerate through the gate.
ejercicios.consejo: The best 1v1 solution is often the simplest route into the space the defender cannot protect.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect close control and a quick technical action with a live duel.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a four-cone slalom ending 8 m before a defender and two mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker completes the slalom, exits at speed and immediately attacks the defender. The defender counterattacks if possession changes.
ejercicios.variantes: Race two attackers through parallel slaloms; change the final move; use the weaker foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the ball close in the slalom, lift the head before the last cone and make the exit touch positive.
ejercicios.consejo: The technical circuit should prepare the duel, not leave the attacker tired or looking down.

ejercicios.objetivo: Beat a defender and finish quickly before recovery.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 15 x 12 m area with two mini-goals placed at different angles behind the defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives, commits the defender and attacks one goal. The finish must come within two touches after beating the defender.
ejercicios.variantes: One goal for the stronger foot and one for the weaker foot; add a six-second limit; change the service angle.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attack at speed but keep control, use the exit touch to prepare the finish and avoid slowing down after the skill.
ejercicios.consejo: A successful dribble has value only when the player completes the next action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve attacking decisions while a defender recovers from behind.
ejercicios.organizacion: The attacker starts 18 m from goal with the defender two to four metres behind and slightly to one side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the signal, the attacker drives toward goal. The defender chases and tries to recover without fouling.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the defender's starting distance; add a goalkeeper; require a finish within seven seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attack the shortest route, protect the ball on the outside foot and decide early whether to shoot or change direction.
ejercicios.consejo: The attacker should use the body and running line before reaching for a skill move.

ejercicios.objetivo: Control a dropping ball and react faster than an opponent before entering a duel.
ejercicios.organizacion: The coach serves an aerial ball into a 12 x 12 m area where two players begin on opposite sides.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Both players compete for the first or second contact. The player who secures possession attacks either target gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Use bouncing service; allow a header into space; add a time limit after the first control.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Track the flight early, adjust the feet, protect the landing zone and make the next action immediately after contact.
ejercicios.consejo: The duel often begins before the ball lands. Body position determines who controls the next action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop the ability to retain possession and escape from pressure toward a useful direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place an attacker near the corner of a 10 x 10 m box with a defender closing from inside. Mark two exit gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker receives under pressure, protects the first contact and escapes through either gate. The defender counterattacks through the start line.
ejercicios.variantes: Start near the touchline; add a neutral wall pass; allow only six seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Receive side-on, keep the first touch away from pressure and use a turn, roll or change of pace to escape forward.
ejercicios.consejo: Escaping sideways may keep the ball, but escaping forward changes the game. Reward useful exits.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve close control, shielding and quick changes of direction under intense pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark an 8 x 8 m square. One attacker keeps the ball against one defender for a short work period.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker scores by crossing any side under control after at least one change of direction. The defender scores by winning and stopping the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce the square; weaker foot only; add four corner gates.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take small touches, use the body to protect, turn away from pressure and avoid becoming trapped on the boundary.
ejercicios.consejo: Keep work periods short so technique and posture remain sharp.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Duel to Reach the Scoring Zone
ejercicios.objetivo: Beat an opponent and enter a target zone with control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 15 x 10 m field with a three-metre scoring zone at each end.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker starts with the ball and scores by entering the far zone under control. The defender can counterattack toward the opposite zone.
ejercicios.variantes: Score only after a change of direction; narrow the scoring zone; use a five-second limit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move the defender away from the target line, keep the ball on the safe side and accelerate into the zone.
ejercicios.consejo: Crossing the line under control is more important than simply kicking the ball beyond the defender.

ejercicios.objetivo: Attack a defender immediately after combining with a support player.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a support player centrally with an attacker behind and a defender five metres ahead. Use two mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker passes into the support, receives the lay-off on the move and attacks the defender.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch lay-off; support can choose either side; add a recovering defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Continue the run after the first pass, receive into forward momentum and attack before the defender can adjust.
ejercicios.consejo: The combination should increase the speed of the duel, not create an extra pause.

ejercicios.objetivo: Build confidence using the weaker foot to carry, protect and escape in a duel.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 12 x 10 m area with one gate on each side of the defender. Every attacker starts with the ball on the weaker foot.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker must use the weaker foot for the first three touches and for the final touch through the gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow either foot for protection; reduce the distance; add a mini-goal finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the ankle relaxed for carrying, use the outside and inside surfaces and avoid transferring the ball too early to the stronger foot.
ejercicios.consejo: Lower the speed at first. Confidence grows from successful repetitions, not forced mistakes.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a visible change of speed to create and exploit separation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a controlled approach zone followed by a live duel zone before two mini-goals.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker enters at moderate speed, slows or pauses to fix the defender, then accelerates past on either side.
ejercicios.variantes: Coach calls slow-fast or fast-slow; add a chasing defender; change the starting angle.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Vary the rhythm, keep the ball close before the burst and use a longer exit touch into open space.
ejercicios.consejo: Constant speed is easy to defend. The change of rhythm should be obvious.

ejercicios.objetivo: Teach attackers to read and exploit a defender who is showing one side.
ejercicios.organizacion: The defender begins in a side-on stance between two gates. The attacker starts eight metres away with the ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker reads the defender's hips and front foot, then chooses whether to attack the shown side or cut across the body.
ejercicios.variantes: Defender changes stance late; add a counter goal; call the preferred exit foot.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attack the front foot, disguise the final direction and keep the ball protected from the defender's tackling foot.
ejercicios.consejo: Body shape gives information, but the attacker must still move the defender before exploiting it.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use an outside support player without losing the intention to attack the defender.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 14 x 12 m area with one mini-goal at each end and a neutral player on one touchline.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker can combine once with the neutral player or attack directly. After losing the ball, roles change immediately.
ejercicios.variantes: Neutral player one touch; move the neutral to the opposite side; allow an overlap after the pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the neutral to change the defender's angle, receive on the move and attack the new space quickly.
ejercicios.consejo: Support should create a better 1v1, not remove the responsibility to be positive.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve shielding, balance and control while an opponent applies close pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use an 8 x 8 m square. The attacker starts with the ball and the defender begins at arm's length.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker protects for a set period without leaving the square. Change roles after every repetition.
ejercicios.variantes: Protect for three, five or eight seconds; allow an escape gate after the time; add a support player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use a low stance, keep the ball far from pressure, move the feet continuously and avoid holding or pushing.
ejercicios.consejo: Protection is a football action, not a wrestling contest. Keep contact controlled and legal.

ejercicios.objetivo: Make fast, clear decisions in a duel without rushing the technique.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set two mini-goals behind the defender in a 14 x 12 m area. The attacker has six seconds from the first touch.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The coach starts the clock as the pass travels. The attacker must score before time expires; the defender counterattacks after a regain.
ejercicios.variantes: Use five or eight seconds; add a second defender after four seconds; score bonus points for early finishes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take information before receiving, attack directly, avoid extra touches and keep the final action controlled.
ejercicios.consejo: Time pressure should remove hesitation, not remove thought.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create and finish a numerical advantage while selecting the best target.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place two mini-goals behind one defender in a 16 x 14 m area. Two attackers start with the ball eight metres away.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball carrier attacks the defender. The second attacker stays wide and adjusts the supporting angle. The pair score in either goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Limit the action to eight seconds; require one pass; allow the defender to counterattack.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep width, carry directly at the defender and pass only after fixing the defender or when the dribble is blocked.
ejercicios.consejo: The two goals force the defender to reveal which space cannot be protected.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve the timing of the pass after drawing the defender toward the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 16 x 10 m channel with one defender centrally and two attackers starting side by side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball carrier drives at the defender. If the defender commits, the pass releases the teammate; if not, the carrier continues to goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a recovering defender; one-touch finish; switch the starting side.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Carry on a direct line, support outside the defender's reach and release the pass at the last useful moment.
ejercicios.consejo: Passing too early removes the overload because the defender can recover to the receiver.

ejercicios.objetivo: Combine accurately in a restricted space while maintaining forward speed.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 18 x 7 m channel with a mini-goal at the far end. Two attackers face one defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Attackers progress through the channel and must finish before crossing the end line. The defender counterattacks to the start gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Two-touch limit; narrow the channel; start the defender closer to goal.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use staggered positions, avoid standing on the same line and play passes into the teammate's forward path.
ejercicios.consejo: Even in a narrow channel, the supporting player must create a different passing angle.

ejercicios.objetivo: Turn a recovery into an immediate numerical attack.
ejercicios.organizacion: Start with a 3v2 possession game in a 12 x 12 m box. Place a mini-goal ten metres outside the area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: When the two defenders regain the ball, the nearest possession player becomes the recovery defender, creating a 2v1 to goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a second target; eight-second limit; require the first pass forward.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: React immediately to the regain, secure the first touch, separate quickly and attack before the recovering player arrives.
ejercicios.consejo: The overload exists for only a few seconds. Transition speed protects the advantage.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use width and a cutback pass to create a close-range finish.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place one attacker wide near the byline, one central attacker and one defender inside the box.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The wide attacker drives toward the end line. The central attacker delays the run, finds space behind the defender and finishes the cutback.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse sides; add a goalkeeper; allow the wide player to finish if the defender blocks the pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Wide player keeps the head up, central attacker arrives late and the pass is played behind the defender into the runner's path.
ejercicios.consejo: A cutback succeeds because the receiver arrives into space rather than waiting inside it.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create confusion for the defender through coordinated crossing movements.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two attackers start five metres apart with one defender centrally and a mini-goal behind.
ejercicios.desarrollo: As the ball carrier advances, the support runner crosses behind or in front. The carrier decides whether to keep, pass or use the run as a decoy.
ejercicios.variantes: Call overlap or underlap; add a recovering defender; require a one-touch finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Time the crossing run, avoid blocking the ball carrier and communicate the intended route early.
ejercicios.consejo: The run is useful even without receiving if it changes the defender's position.

ejercicios.objetivo: Finish the overload before a second defender recovers into the action.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two attackers start 22 m from goal against one defender. A second defender begins five metres behind the attackers.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the signal, the attackers break forward. They must create and finish the 2v1 before the recovering defender can balance the situation.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the recovery distance; eight-second limit; add a goalkeeper.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attack at full speed, keep the support player outside the first defender and make the final decision early.
ejercicios.consejo: The recovering defender is the clock. Extra touches allow the advantage to disappear.

ejercicios.objetivo: Apply 2v1 principles in a realistic finishing situation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set two attackers 25 m from a full-size goal, one defender 18 m out and a goalkeeper in goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attackers combine or dribble to create a clear finish. If the defender or goalkeeper wins the ball, play ends.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a recovering defender; start from a diagonal pass; limit the number of passes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Commit the defender, keep the second attacker on a different line and finish with minimal touches once the chance opens.
ejercicios.consejo: The objective is not to complete a pass; it is to create the highest-quality finish.

ejercicios.objetivo: Increase scanning and speed of play within a simple overload.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 16 x 12 m area with one mini-goal. Two attackers play against one defender with a two-touch limit.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attackers must progress and finish while staying available on different lines. The defender counterattacks on recovery.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch for the support player; free touches for the ball carrier; add a second target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before receiving, open the body, play into space and move immediately after the pass.
ejercicios.consejo: Touch limits should improve preparation and support, not create blind one-touch football.

ejercicios.objetivo: Exploit a numerical advantage immediately after possession changes.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a small-sided game in one zone with a target goal outside. Nominate two players to break and one defender to recover.
ejercicios.desarrollo: When the coach calls transition or a team wins the ball, two attackers break quickly against the nearest defender.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the transition signal; add a second recovering defender; score within eight seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: First action forward, sprint into separate lanes and communicate early so the carrier knows the available options.
ejercicios.consejo: A good transition starts with the reaction of players without the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use a neutral player to maintain an overload and create new passing angles.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a 14 x 12 m area with 1v1 inside and a neutral player on one side. Place a mini-goal at each end.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player in possession attacks with the neutral, creating 2v1. After a turnover, the neutral immediately supports the new attacker.
ejercicios.variantes: Neutral one touch; move the neutral inside; rotate every two minutes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Neutral player supports at an angle, moves as the ball moves and returns passes into forward space.
ejercicios.consejo: The neutral should speed up the attack, not become a safe place to hide the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Read the defender and select the stronger side of the overload.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place one mini-goal in each corner behind the defender. Two attackers begin centrally with the ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The defender protects the space between goals. Attackers choose which side to overload and finish.
ejercicios.variantes: Coach blocks one goal late; switch the support side; limit the action to six seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Support stays wide enough to stretch the defender, carrier attacks the central space and both players adapt late.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not decide the target before the defender moves. Read the picture as it develops.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create a fast finishing chance in a crowded scoring area.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place two attackers and one defender inside the penalty area. A server starts outside with several balls.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The server plays into either attacker. The pair have six seconds and a maximum of three passes to finish.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch finish; add a recovering defender; use cutback and rebound services.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create separation with short movements, play away from the defender and finish quickly when the shooting lane appears.
ejercicios.consejo: Inside the box, the overload must produce a shot before the defence can recover.

ejercicios.objetivo: Receive between lines and combine forward against one defender.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place a passer behind two attackers who begin on different lines in front of one defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The passer plays vertically into the advanced attacker. The second attacker supports immediately to create the 2v1 toward goal.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch set; add a defender behind the receiver; switch the vertical passing lane.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Receiver checks the shoulder, protects the first touch and uses the supporting player only when the defender commits.
ejercicios.consejo: The support run should begin as the vertical pass travels, not after the receiver controls.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create a clear final pass that allows a first-time finish.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two attackers start against one defender 20 m from goal. Mark a finishing zone eight to twelve metres from goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball carrier commits the defender and releases the teammate. Any finish inside the marked zone must be first time.
ejercicios.variantes: Alternate sides; add a goalkeeper; require a cutback or square pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Support stays onside, arrives at the correct moment and adjusts the feet before the final pass arrives.
ejercicios.consejo: A one-touch finish depends on the quality and timing of the pass as much as the striker.

ejercicios.objetivo: Compete safely for an aerial ball and react immediately to the second ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two players stand under a central service with a support teammate behind each player. Mark a target gate at either end.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The coach serves high. Players challenge for the first ball, then all four react to win the second ball and attack a gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Use headed or controlled chest contact; vary the service; add a five-second scoring limit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Track the ball, establish position early, jump safely and react forward as soon as the first contact is made.
ejercicios.consejo: The second-ball reaction often decides the duel more than the first header.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop balance and legal shoulder contact while running with the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 15 m lane. Two players start side by side with the ball slightly ahead and a target line at the end.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Both players race to gain control and carry across the target line. Shoulder contact is allowed only when both are balanced and level.
ejercicios.variantes: Use a curved lane; start from walking speed; add a mini-goal after the line.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Stay upright, keep arms close, contact shoulder to shoulder and avoid leaning or charging from behind.
ejercicios.consejo: Introduce contact progressively and stop any action that becomes unsafe or uncontrolled.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Protect the Ball for Five Seconds
ejercicios.objetivo: Retain possession for a short period under active pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark an 8 x 8 m square. The attacker receives with the defender one metre away.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker must keep the ball for five seconds, then escape through any side. The defender scores by winning and controlling it.
ejercicios.variantes: Change to three or seven seconds; add a neutral pass; weaker foot only after the escape.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the body as a shield, move the ball when the defender changes side and stay balanced through contact.
ejercicios.consejo: Count only controlled possession. Simply kicking the ball away does not complete the task.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link individual elimination with a second phase of combination play.
ejercicios.organizacion: Begin with a 1v1 in a 10 x 8 m zone. A support attacker waits beyond the zone and a second defender starts near goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: If the attacker escapes the first duel, the support joins to create a 2v1 toward goal against the second defender.
ejercicios.variantes: The first defender recovers; require a pass in the 2v1; reverse the direction.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Finish the first duel with a forward exit, lift the head immediately and recognise whether to pass or keep driving.
ejercicios.consejo: Players must reset their information after winning the first duel; the second picture is different.

ejercicios.objetivo: Turn an organised press into a live duel after the pressing trigger.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a small possession box with one outside receiver and a mini-goal beyond. A defender waits for a poor touch or backward pass.
ejercicios.desarrollo: When the trigger appears, the defender presses the receiver. The receiver must protect, escape and attack the mini-goal.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the trigger; add a support pass; allow a counter goal for the defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Press from an angle, arrive under control and force play one way. Receiver scans early and protects the first touch.
ejercicios.consejo: A press should create a predictable duel, not a reckless sprint toward the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Recover the ball in a duel and attack immediately in the opposite direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place one mini-goal at each end of a 16 x 10 m field. One player begins as attacker and the other as defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The attacker attacks one goal. If the defender wins the ball, the roles reverse instantly and the opposite goal becomes active.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a five-second counter window; bonus for winning and scoring; start from a coach pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Defender secures the regain with the first touch, lifts the head and accelerates before the former attacker can recover.
ejercicios.consejo: The best reward for a strong defensive action is an immediate positive attack.

ejercicios.objetivo: Apply 1v1 skills competitively across several short formats.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create four small pitches with different targets: gates, mini-goals, end zones and timed possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players compete in 45-second matches and rotate after each round. Award points for wins, draws and bonus actions.
ejercicios.variantes: Use ability-based groups; team scoring; promotion and relegation between pitches.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep repetitions intense, enforce fair contact and reward positive attacking and disciplined defending.
ejercicios.consejo: Competition should reveal habits. Note which players scan, commit and accelerate consistently.

ejercicios.objetivo: Repeat 2v1 decisions at speed with immediate role rotation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Set a goal at each end of a 25 x 18 m area. Three players begin at one end: two attackers and one defender.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The pair attacks the far goal. After the action, the player who finished or lost the ball becomes defender against two new attackers coming back.
ejercicios.variantes: Add goalkeepers; two-touch limit; include a recovering defender.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Transition quickly into the next role, keep the field wide and make the decision before entering the final zone.
ejercicios.consejo: Continuous waves produce match-like fatigue, so preserve spacing and decision quality.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect technical and tactical principles from 1v1 and 2v1 situations.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build three stations: a 1v1 gate duel, a protection-and-turn duel and a 2v1 to mini-goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Groups work for four minutes at each station, then rotate. Finish with one full circuit where the actions run in sequence.
ejercicios.variantes: Add scoring; use weaker-foot rounds; change defender starting positions.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Identify the numerical picture early: in 1v1, commit and beat; in 2v1, commit and release at the correct moment.
ejercicios.consejo: A circuit is useful only when the coaching detail of each duel remains clear.

ejercicios.objetivo: Transfer 1v1 and 2v1 decisions into an open, competitive game.
ejercicios.organizacion: Play 4v4 to 7v7 with goals. Mark wide channels or central bonus zones where duels and overloads can be rewarded.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A goal counts double when it follows a successful 1v1, a well-timed 2v1 or a regain followed by a direct attack.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the bonus every four minutes; add neutral players; award points for defensive duel wins.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use individual actions only when they improve the attack, support the ball carrier early and react immediately after possession changes.
ejercicios.consejo: Reward the right decision, not dribbling for its own sake. The duel should serve the game.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop scanning, body orientation, passing speed and support around the player on the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 10 to 14 m square. Place four to six possession players around the outside and the defenders inside. Use two identical areas when numbers allow.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Outside players circulate the ball and adjust after every pass. When a defender wins it, the player responsible enters the middle or the defenders try to dribble out for a point.
ejercicios.variantes: One or two touches; count consecutive passes; add a second ball; allow defenders to score by escaping the square.
