ejercicios.puntos_clave: Receive side-on, play away from pressure and pass with the correct weight. Supporting players must create clear angles rather than stand behind defenders.
ejercicios.consejo: The smaller the area, the earlier players must scan and prepare their next action.

ejercicios.objetivo: Keep the ball under pressure and react immediately when possession changes.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 10 to 14 m square. Place four to six possession players around the outside and the defenders inside. Use two identical areas when numbers allow.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The possession team combines until the defenders regain the ball. On the regain, the defenders attack a gate or mini-goal while the team that lost it counterpresses for five seconds.
ejercicios.variantes: Add two mini-goals; give a double point for escaping cleanly; rotate defenders after every regain.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Secure the first pass after regaining. After losing the ball, close the nearest options before chasing the ball carrier.
ejercicios.consejo: The first reaction after a turnover often decides whether possession is truly secured.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve close support, short passing and composure when space is limited.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a square between 8 x 8 m and 14 x 14 m according to the age and technical level. Place one or two defenders inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team in possession moves the ball while players continually adjust their position to offer width, depth and support. Play restarts immediately after the ball leaves the area.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce the square; use a one-touch bonus; rotate the defenders every 30 seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan before receiving, open the body, play to the correct foot and move again after every pass. Keep useful distances between players.
ejercicios.consejo: Correct the distances between players before demanding faster passing.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use outside support to create overloads, switch play and maintain useful width.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a central 4v4 or 5v5 area with one support player on each outside line. Outside players play for the team in possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The inside team keeps possession and can use the outside supports to escape pressure. Supports return the ball quickly and change position after each action.
ejercicios.variantes: Outside players use one touch; score after using two different sides; rotate supports every two minutes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Do not force the outside pass. Attract pressure inside, then use the free support with the correct timing.
ejercicios.consejo: Outside players should accelerate circulation, not slow it down.

ejercicios.objetivo: Build collective support, patience and concentration during sustained possession.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 24 x 20 m area with two teams of five to eight players. A team scores one point for completing ten consecutive passes.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The count returns to zero after a loss. The team that regains the ball starts its own count immediately, encouraging fast role changes.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce the target to six passes; add neutral players; award two points after a switch of play.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Players should spread early, communicate the count and avoid low-value passes into crowded areas.
ejercicios.consejo: Counted passes create focus, but the objective remains to move the defending team.

ejercicios.objetivo: Recognise pressure, protect the ball and find the safest route out of a compact area.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 12 x 12 m starting zone connected to a larger escape zone. Begin with a numerical advantage for the possession team.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team completes three passes in the starting zone, then attempts to play or carry into the escape zone. Defenders press actively and counterattack after a regain.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a second defender; permit one neutral support; require the exit pass to break a line.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create a free player behind or beside the press. Use a bounce pass when the forward option is closed and accelerate once the line is broken.
ejercicios.consejo: Playing out of pressure begins with calm body orientation and a clear supporting triangle.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve ball circulation, support angles and collective decision-making under realistic pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Divide a 28 x 18 m rectangle into two equal zones. Place a possession group and defenders in each half.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Complete a set number of passes in one zone before transferring the ball to a teammate in the opposite zone. Defenders shift across after the transfer.
ejercicios.variantes: Require a first-time switch; allow one player to travel with the pass; add an end target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attract pressure in the active zone, prepare the far-side receiving angle and pass only when the transfer lane is open.
ejercicios.consejo: A switch is effective only after the defending team has been drawn toward the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Find and use a free player inside the opposition shape to connect possession.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 20 x 18 m area and place one neutral player in a central pocket. The neutral always plays with the team in possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams keep possession and receive a bonus when the central player connects one side of the area to the other. The neutral must move away from cover shadows.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch for the neutral; two central players; score only after a third-player combination.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: The central player scans both shoulders and receives side-on. Teammates should create the passing lane before demanding the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: The central player becomes useful through timing and orientation, not by standing in the middle.

ejercicios.objetivo: Recognise when the opponent has shifted and switch play toward the free side.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a wide 30 x 20 m area with target channels on both sides. Start with a slight overload for the team in possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team attracts pressure on one side through short combinations, then switches the ball into the opposite channel for a point.
ejercicios.variantes: Require three passes before switching; use a long pass or a two-pass route through a central player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the far-side player wide and ready. The switch should arrive with enough pace to exploit the space before defenders recover.
ejercicios.consejo: Do not switch because the rule demands it; switch because the pressure has created space elsewhere.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve positional occupation, support between lines and creation of the free player.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 28 x 22 m area divided into three vertical lanes. Add neutral players who always support the team in possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team in possession uses the neutrals to create overloads and move the ball from one side to the other. A point is scored for connecting the two outside lanes.
ejercicios.variantes: Limit neutral players to one touch; require one player in each lane; add end targets.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Maintain width and depth, avoid placing several teammates on the same line and move as the ball travels.
ejercicios.consejo: Positional play is designed to create a free player, not to keep players in fixed spots.

ejercicios.objetivo: Increase scanning and passing speed without losing accuracy or support.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 22 x 18 m possession area with two teams and two neutral players. Begin with free play before adding touch limits.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Play in blocks of two minutes. Alternate free touches, two touches and one-touch zones to test preparation before receiving.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch only in the outside lanes; free touch after a regain; bonus for a one-touch switch.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Touch limits should improve decisions, not create panic. Open the body and know the next option before receiving.
ejercicios.consejo: Use constraints to reveal better habits, then remove them and look for transfer into free play.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create diagonal passing angles and continuous support around the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Arrange four outside players in a diamond around a 14 x 14 m area with two defenders inside and one support player moving between lines.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball travels around the diamond. Players rotate after passes and use the central support whenever the passing lane appears.
ejercicios.variantes: Reverse direction after five passes; add a second defender; require a third-player action.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move early to preserve the diamond. Pass to the receiver's front foot and avoid flattening the shape.
ejercicios.consejo: Diagonal support gives the player on the ball more than one safe solution.

ejercicios.objetivo: Secure possession after a regain before deciding whether to progress.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 20 x 18 m area with two teams of four to six and two outside targets. Keep spare balls beside the coach.
ejercicios.desarrollo: After winning the ball, the team must complete three secure passes before it can score through an outside target. Immediate pressure follows every loss.
ejercicios.variantes: Reduce to two passes; add a five-second counterattack option; use a neutral player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: The first pass should escape pressure. Teammates must expand quickly while maintaining one close safety option.
ejercicios.consejo: The first controlled pass after a regain turns a defensive action into real possession.

ejercicios.objetivo: Keep possession with purpose and recognise open forward passing lanes.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place six small gates around a 24 x 20 m possession area. Two balanced teams play inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A team scores by passing through any free gate to a teammate. The same gate cannot be used twice in succession.
ejercicios.variantes: Require five passes before scoring; use colour-coded gates; allow a dribble through the gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Look away from the ball to identify the next gate. Supporting players should arrive on different sides of the target.
ejercicios.consejo: Targets give possession direction and discourage passing without an objective.

ejercicios.objetivo: Increase awareness, communication and technical speed in a demanding rondo.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 14 x 14 m rondo with six outside players and two defenders. Start two balls from opposite sides.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Both balls remain active. Players must scan continuously, avoid passing into the same space and communicate before receiving.
ejercicios.variantes: Use one ball after 45 seconds; add a third defender; award a point for 15 total passes.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Check both shoulders and manage the rhythm. Accuracy is more important than forcing one-touch play.
ejercicios.consejo: Two balls expose players who watch only the ball nearest to them.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create width, support inside and the ability to circulate across the full pitch.
ejercicios.organizacion: Divide a 30 x 21 m field into three vertical channels. Play 5v5 or 6v6 with one neutral player if required.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team keeps possession while maintaining occupation of all three channels. A point is scored after moving the ball from one outside channel to the other.
ejercicios.variantes: Only one player per outside channel; allow rotations after each pass; add target players.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Do not crowd the central lane. The far-side player must stay connected but wide enough to stretch the opposition.
ejercicios.consejo: Width is useful when it creates a longer defensive shift and a clearer next pass.

ejercicios.objetivo: Develop constant movement and three-directional support around the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build a 20 x 20 m area with four corner support zones. Play 4v4 inside and place one neutral support in two opposite corners.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The possession team must always provide a player behind, beside and ahead of the ball. Corner supports can be used to reset and change the angle.
ejercicios.variantes: Move supports every minute; require a rotation after using a corner; play with two touches.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move while the pass is travelling. The nearest player supports; others stretch the area and prepare the next action.
ejercicios.consejo: The player without the ball often creates the decisive solution through positioning.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Keep Possession and Find the Target Player
ejercicios.objetivo: Keep possession while recognising the correct moment to play forward into a target.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 26 x 18 m area with one target player in each end zone. Teams keep possession in the central area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A point is scored by finding the target player after a controlled sequence. The passer replaces the target to maintain movement.
ejercicios.variantes: Minimum four passes; one-touch target; target lays off to a third player for two points.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Do not force the forward pass. Draw defenders, create a clear lane and support underneath the target.
ejercicios.consejo: Progress when the line is open; recycle when the forward pass would only lose the ball.

ejercicios.objetivo: Adapt quickly to changing roles while preserving the team's possession structure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 5v5 possession area with two neutral players. Neutral players rotate with inside players whenever the coach calls a number.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Play continues during the rotation. Players must recognise their new role and rebuild width, depth and support immediately.
ejercicios.variantes: Rotate after every regain; change two players at once; add a touch limit during transitions.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Communicate before the rotation and fill the most important space first. Avoid multiple players moving into the same area.
ejercicios.consejo: Good possession structures survive rotations because players understand the principles, not fixed positions.

ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain technical quality and collective concentration in a competitive format.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create three or four small rondo areas. Divide the squad into equal teams and assign one or two defenders in each area.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams play short rounds and score for consecutive passes, clean escapes after regaining and immediate counterpressure. Winners move up one field.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the rondo numbers; use one-touch bonus rounds; finish with a championship round.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Competition should raise intensity without reducing the quality of first touch, support and passing weight.
ejercicios.consejo: Reward the behaviours you want to see, not only the final score.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve movement around blocked spaces and create passing lanes away from pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 24 x 20 m area with a central 6 x 6 m restricted square. Players may pass through it but cannot remain inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The teams keep possession by moving around the restricted zone. The rule encourages new angles and prevents players from occupying the same space.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow one neutral player inside; move the restricted zone; score after a pass across it.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move around the obstacle rather than standing behind it. Use diagonal passes and third-player support.
ejercicios.consejo: Removing one space can help players discover several better spaces around it.

ejercicios.objetivo: Move a compact defensive unit and identify the moment to play through, around or beyond it.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 32 x 24 m area. Place six possession players around a compact block of four defenders, with target gates at both ends.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The possession team circulates around the block and looks for a clear pass between or around defenders. Defenders shift together and counter through a gate after regaining.
ejercicios.variantes: Require a switch before scoring; add a neutral between lines; shorten the time available.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move the block with patient circulation, then accelerate through the opening. Avoid forcing passes into closed central spaces.
ejercicios.consejo: The ball should travel faster than the defensive block can shift.

ejercicios.objetivo: Connect ball retention to forward progression without losing collective balance.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create three connected zones. Start with a rondo, continue through a middle possession zone and finish in an end zone or mini-goal.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players must secure the ball in each zone before progressing. After a loss, the nearest group counterpresses while the others protect the next zone.
ejercicios.variantes: Use different player numbers in each zone; permit a dribble to break one line; add a final finish.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Know when to retain and when to accelerate. Support behind the ball so one failed forward pass does not expose the entire team.
ejercicios.consejo: Possession prepares progression; it should not replace it.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create and exploit overloads in wide areas while maintaining central support.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 30 x 20 m field with two wide channels. Place one neutral wide player in each channel.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team in possession uses the wide neutral players to create 2v1 situations and switch the point of attack. A point is scored after connecting both wings.
ejercicios.variantes: One touch for wide players; allow overlaps into the channel; add mini-goals after the switch.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Attract pressure centrally before using the wide overload. The nearest central player supports underneath the winger.
ejercicios.consejo: A wide overload is strongest when the opposite side remains ready for the next switch.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use triangular support to play away from pressure and exit through the free side.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two 12 x 12 m triangles using cones. Place three possession players on the outside and one or two defenders inside.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players pass and rotate around the triangle. After three passes, they can escape through a gate at one corner while defenders attempt to block the exit.
ejercicios.variantes: Add a central neutral player; reverse direction; set a six-second escape limit.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep three different angles around the ball. The first touch should take the receiver away from the defender.
ejercicios.consejo: A clear triangle gives the ball carrier a forward, sideways and safety option.

ejercicios.objetivo: Transfer possession principles into a larger, match-related space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use one half of the pitch with a 6v6 or 7v7 possession game. Add two wide neutral players and one central target.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams keep possession and score by switching through both wide players before finding the central target. Restarts come from the coach.
ejercicios.variantes: Add mini-goals; allow the target to finish; reduce the number of neutral players.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the full width and depth of the half. Maintain security behind the ball before committing players forward.
ejercicios.consejo: Larger spaces reward early scanning and longer support distances.

ejercicios.objetivo: Improve scanning, communication and rapid adaptation while keeping the ball.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place four coloured gates around a 22 x 18 m area. Two teams play possession while the coach holds matching colour cards.
ejercicios.desarrollo: After a short passing sequence, the coach calls a colour. The team in possession must quickly identify and play through the matching gate.
ejercicios.variantes: Call two colours in order; use a visual signal only; make the nearest defender protect the called gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Players should scan the gates before the signal and keep the ball moving while reorganising.
ejercicios.consejo: A late signal tests whether players are observing beyond the immediate pass.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use lay-offs and third-player movement to retain the ball and break pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 24 x 18 m area with two teams and one central support. Place small target gates on the end lines.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The possession team looks for a forward pass into the support player, a one-touch lay-off and a third-player pass into the opposite half.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch lay-off; add a second central support; finish through a gate after the combination.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: The third player moves before the lay-off arrives. The support player sets the ball away from pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: A lay-off is most effective when it releases a teammate already moving forward.

ejercicios.objetivo: Create depth, connect lines and progress while preserving positional balance.
ejercicios.organizacion: Divide a 30 x 20 m area into three horizontal lines. Play 5v5 with one neutral player allowed to move between lines.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team must connect players in all three lines to score. Players can rotate, but each line must remain occupied.
ejercicios.variantes: One player may break a line by dribbling; limit touches in the middle line; add end targets.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Offer different heights around the ball. Avoid having all players come short at the same time.
ejercicios.consejo: Depth gives the team somewhere to go after the first line of pressure is beaten.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use third-player combinations to bypass a defender and continue possession forward.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 24 x 18 m possession game with two teams and two neutral players. Mark small target zones at opposite corners.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A point is scored when player A passes to B, B sets the ball and player C receives beyond the pressure. The pattern must emerge from live play.
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch set; reverse the direction; allow a finish after the third-player action.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: The third player starts away from the ball and arrives as the set pass is played. The first pass must attract pressure.
ejercicios.consejo: The third player attacks the space that the first receiver cannot see directly.

ejercicios.objetivo: Keep possession when the opposition launches an organised press.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 26 x 20 m area with two teams and two outside supports. Defenders may press fully only after a chosen trigger.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The trigger can be a backwards pass, a poor touch or a pass to one side. The possession team must recognise the pressure and escape or secure the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the trigger; add a five-second escape bonus; allow a direct pass to an end target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Identify the trigger early, give the receiver a safety pass and use the space left by the pressing defenders.
ejercicios.consejo: Every press closes one space and opens another.

ejercicios.objetivo: Link possession, counterpressure and fast attacking decisions after turnovers.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark a 24 x 20 m central area with two mini-goals at each end. Play 4v4 and keep spare balls with the coach.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams first aim to complete four passes. After regaining, they may either secure possession or counterattack a mini-goal within six seconds.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the required passes; add neutral players; double points for a goal after a clean regain.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Expand when possession is secure and contract immediately after losing it. The first player presses while teammates close passing lanes.
ejercicios.consejo: A good transition decision depends on whether the space is open or the ball needs to be secured first.

ejercicios.objetivo: Maintain possession principles during repeated attack-defence transitions.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 30 x 22 m field with two teams and a waiting group beside each end. New players enter immediately after a goal or turnover.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The team that attacks must first complete a short possession sequence. When the action ends, the defending group becomes the next attacking group.
ejercicios.variantes: Use 3v3, 4v4 or 5v5 waves; add a neutral player; limit each action to 45 seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Reorganise quickly after each wave. Keep one safe player behind the ball and communicate role changes early.
ejercicios.consejo: Continuous formats develop the habit of reorganising before fatigue removes clarity.

ejercicios.objetivo: Use width to stretch the opposition and create new central passing lanes.
ejercicios.organizacion: Use a 28 x 20 m area with two wide channels. Teams play 5v5 or 6v6, with wide channels initially unopposed.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Normal possession scores one point after six passes. The point doubles when the sequence uses both wide channels before completion.
ejercicios.variantes: Allow defenders into the channel after the first touch; require a switch in three passes; add target players.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Wide players stay open until the ball travels. Central players support the switch and protect against the next turnover.
ejercicios.consejo: Width is not distance for its own sake; it creates room for the next player.

ejercicios.material: balls, cones, bibs, goals or mini-goals
ejercicios.objetivo: Use possession to prepare a controlled, well-timed attack on goal.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 36 x 26 m small-sided field with goals. Teams must complete a set number of passes before they may finish.
ejercicios.desarrollo: After the pass target is reached, the team can attack either goal freely. A regain in the attacking half reduces the required number of passes.
ejercicios.variantes: Change the pass target; add wide neutral players; allow an immediate finish after a line-breaking pass.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Do not pass only to satisfy the rule. Attract defenders, create a free player and attack as soon as the opportunity is genuine.
ejercicios.consejo: The best moment to finish often appears just after the opposition has shifted toward the ball.

ejercicios.titulo_original: Small-Sided Game with a Possession Objective
ejercicios.material: balls, cones, bibs, 2 goals or 4 mini-goals
ejercicios.objetivo: Transfer ball-retention principles into a realistic game with goals and transitions.
ejercicios.organizacion: Organise a 5v5 to 8v8 small-sided game. Add one simple possession rule and keep restarts fast.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Teams receive bonus points for purposeful possession, switching play, finding a free player and progressing after drawing pressure. Finish with a free-play round.
ejercicios.variantes: Minimum passes before scoring; double goal after a switch; neutral player for the team in possession.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Possession must have an intention: attract, move and then progress. Remove rules gradually and observe whether the behaviours remain.
ejercicios.consejo: Good possession is measured by the spaces and chances it creates, not only by the number of passes.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Gradually activate the body while restoring the feel for dribbling and close ball control.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark out an 18 to 22 metre square. Every player enters the area with a ball. Create four small gates along the sides of the square.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble freely. Every 20 seconds, call out an instruction: inside of the foot, outside, sole, changes of direction or quick footwork. On the signal, each player accelerates toward a free gate, goes through it and returns to the square. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Use the weaker foot; require a skill move before each gate; add a change of pace after going through.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Start at low intensity, use many small touches and regularly lift the head to avoid collisions.
ejercicios.consejo: A good opening game should wake up the feet without causing fatigue. Increase the intensity only during the

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Develop reaction speed, ball control and the ability to change pace immediately.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 20 metre square. Place one green, one yellow and one red cone on one side as reminders of the three commands.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Everyone dribbles inside the square. Green: accelerate with the ball. Yellow: slow down, stop the ball with the sole and look around. Red: stop the ball and protect it for three seconds. Restart quickly with a new color. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Add blue for a change of direction; show the color without speaking; require a feint before restarting.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Vary the intervals, keep space between players and avoid stops that are too long.
ejercicios.consejo: Demonstrate the three actions before starting. A ten-second demonstration prevents long explanations.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Stimulate scanning, orientation and quick dribbling toward an identified space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Spread twelve markers in four colors across a 20 x 20 metre area. Players move around with their balls.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Call out a color. Players must find a matching marker, approach it with a change of direction and move away immediately. Limit each marker to two players so everyone has to scan and choose.
ejercicios.variantes: Assign an action to each color; call two colors to be touched in sequence; use a visual signal.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Players should lift their heads before the call and while moving. Reward the right decision, not only speed.
ejercicios.consejo: Avoid elimination. A player who arrives late can simply complete a small technical task before rejoining.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Improve coordination, footwork and ball control while following a partner.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create small 8 x 5 metre channels. Two players face each other, each with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: For 25 seconds, the leader moves forward, backward and sideways with the ball. The partner copies the movements like a mirror. Switch roles after every repetition and complete six repetitions. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Play without the ball in the first round; use only the weaker foot; add a final acceleration toward a line.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep the upper body stable, bend the knees and use short touches to stay synchronized.
ejercicios.consejo: Pair players of a similar level. The leader should offer controllable movements rather than trying to trick the

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Create repeated changes of direction and learn to identify a free passing gate quickly.
ejercicios.organizacion: Build eight gates in different colors inside a 22 x 22 metre area. Leave enough space between all gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Each player scores one point by dribbling through a gate. The same gate cannot be used twice in a row. After 45 seconds, allow 20 seconds of active recovery and repeat four times.
ejercicios.variantes: Use a designated foot; perform a feint before the gate; award two points for the farthest gates.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Look before changing direction, slow down slightly to prepare the action and accelerate after the gate.
ejercicios.consejo: Count the gates crossed, but especially praise players who use several directions and both feet.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Work on dribbling, braking and intelligent use of space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place several small islands inside a 20 metre square. Use fewer islands than players, but allow two players on each island.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Players dribble between the islands. On the signal, they move to a free island, stop the ball and perform a called action: five sole touches, three stepovers or one complete turn.
ejercicios.variantes: Gradually reduce the number of islands; require a specific color; GAME DIAGRAM restart with a five-metre acceleration.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Brake before the island, check the available space and never push another player to enter.
ejercicios.consejo: Keep the game inclusive: nobody is eliminated. Players without a place perform the action beside an island

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Create a playful activation using dribbling, acceleration and cooperation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place all balls in a central supply area. Each team has a home marked by four cones in one corner of the field.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the signal, one player from each team collects a ball, dribbles it to the team home and releases the next teammate. The game ends when the central supply is empty. The team with the most balls wins the round. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Move the ball with passes in pairs; add a slalom; allow stealing from the homes only during the final thirty seconds.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: One ball per trip, the next player starts only after the teammate returns, and the ball must remain controlled into the home.
ejercicios.consejo: Use several short rounds. Change the way the ball is transported so the activity does not become a simple

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Activate the feet and link changes of direction during continuous movement.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a winding course with ten cones. Players line up two or three metres apart, each with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The first player guides the group around the cones and chooses the actions: inside-outside touches, sole rolls, turns or acceleration. After 40 seconds, the leader moves to the back and a new leader takes over. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Create two snakes; follow without the ball and then with the ball; add a group sprint to a line.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Maintain the spacing, do not cut across the course and adjust the speed so the whole group keeps moving.
ejercicios.consejo: The snake should flow smoothly. If it stretches too much, reduce the speed or create two smaller groups.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Warm up through a duel while working on shielding and changes of direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create several 8 x 8 metre squares. In each square, the mouse has the ball and the cat starts two metres away.
ejercicios.desarrollo: For 20 seconds, the mouse dribbles and protects the ball. At first, the cat only tries to stay within arm’s length without tackling. On the second repetition, the cat can touch the ball to score a point. Switch roles. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Limit the mouse to one foot; enlarge or reduce the square; award a bonus point if the mouse crosses a gate.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the body without pushing, keep the ball on the far foot and stay light on the feet.
ejercicios.consejo: Begin with passive opposition. Active duels should only start once the players are properly warmed up.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Combine dribbling, scanning and acceleration against light pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark out a 20 x 12 metre channel. Two defenders without balls occupy the central area. The other players line up on the two end lines with balls.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the signal, the attackers cross to reach the opposite side. Defenders try to touch a ball, not the player. Each ball touched earns one point for the defender, and the attacker continues. Change defenders every 45 seconds. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Add a safe zone; use only the weaker foot; reduce the number of attackers released at the same time.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Lift the head, choose a free gap and accelerate after committing a defender.
ejercicios.consejo: Without elimination, the tempo stays high and every player accumulates more repetitions.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Activate off-the-ball movement and improve passing accuracy under pressure.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark out an 18 to 22 metre square. Two hunters wear bibs. The other players move in pairs with one ball between two.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Partners pass while moving. The hunters try to touch a ball while it is travelling or intercept it. When a hunter succeeds, the hunter switches places with the player who lost the ball.
ejercicios.variantes: Limit players to two touches; pass only with the weaker foot; use three hunters for a large group.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Create a passing angle, move after the pass and avoid staying too close to the partner.
ejercicios.consejo: Hunters must target the ball and not block the players’ running paths. Reinforce this rule before every round.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Quickly establish a rhythm of passing and movement before the main activity.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a diamond with four cones. Distribute players at the corners and place one ball in each of two opposite lines.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The player passes to the next cone and follows the ball to join that line. Both balls move in the same direction. After two minutes, reverse the direction and change the type of pass.
ejercicios.variantes: Require an open-body first touch; play one-touch; pass diagonally and then move sideways.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Prepare before receiving, pass to the correct foot and accelerate after releasing the ball.
ejercicios.consejo: Add the second ball only after the pattern is understood. Fluency matters more than speed.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Coordinate passing, directional first touches and movement around a central space.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create a 12 metre square and place two or more players at each corner. Start with one ball at every corner.
ejercicios.desarrollo: All players pass simultaneously to the next corner and move in the opposite direction to the pass. The receiver takes the first touch outward before passing. Change the direction of circulation after 90 seconds. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: One-touch play; diagonal passes; add a feint before the first touch.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Synchronize the starts, communicate and control away from the paths of the other balls.
ejercicios.consejo: If four balls create too much disorder, begin with two and increase gradually.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Develop reaction, support runs and the ability to free a space quickly.
ejercicios.organizacion: In each 8 metre square, four players occupy the corners and one player stands in the centre. One corner player has the ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The ball carrier passes to a teammate. During the pass, the two players without the ball may exchange corners. The central player tries to occupy a free corner. The player who loses a place moves to the centre. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Play without a ball first to learn the pattern; use one-touch passing; call the direction of the exchanges.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Look before passing, start at the right moment and do not run across the centre of the square.
ejercicios.consejo: This game works very well in small groups. Prepare several squares to avoid waiting.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: React to a signal and enter a dribbling or duel situation quickly.
ejercicios.organizacion: Two teams stand facing each other fifteen metres apart. Give every player a number. Place a ball in the centre and a gate behind each team.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Call a number. The two selected players sprint toward the ball. The player who takes it tries to dribble through the opposing gate while the other defends. The action lasts no more than eight seconds, then both return to their teams. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Call two numbers for a 2v2; roll the ball instead of placing it; provide two possible gates.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: React only to the correct number, secure the first touch and keep the duels short.
ejercicios.consejo: After several duels, call the players who have participated least often to balance the workload.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Combine mental reaction, dribbling and changes of direction.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place four numbered cones around a square. Players dribble freely in the centre with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Call a number and an action. Everyone moves to the matching cone, completes the action and returns: turn, sole roll, feint, figure eight around the cone or acceleration.
ejercicios.variantes: Show the number with your fingers; call a simple addition; ask GAME DIAGRAM players to move toward the opposite number.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan the reference points before the signal and control speed when approaching the cone.
ejercicios.consejo: Change the order of the numbers frequently so players do not simply follow the group.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Gradually increase intensity with a collective technical challenge.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create several identical channels with a short slalom, a turning zone and a return line.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The first player completes the course with the ball, returns and passes it to the next player. A round ends when everyone has completed the course. Award one point for speed and one point for control to discourage uncontrolled running.
ejercicios.variantes: Use the weaker foot; return with a pass; complete the course in pairs; add a gate before the handover.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Keep lines short, start only after the ball is received and maintain control around the cones.
ejercicios.consejo: For a large group, create more channels. An effective relay should provide more action than waiting.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Prepare players for changes of pace and fast decisions in 1v1 situations.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two 10 x 8 metre fields with two small gates on each end line. Players wait in pairs along one side.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The coach plays a ball into the field. Both players enter and have eight seconds to score by dribbling through an opposing gate. The action ends after a point, the ball leaves the field or time expires. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Start with backs to the field; assign a color to each gate; progress to 2v2.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Take the first touch into space, make a clear change of pace and leave the field quickly after the action.
ejercicios.consejo: Use very short rounds and allow at least thirty seconds before the same player enters another duel.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Warm up with short accelerations, feints and exits from a zone.
ejercicios.organizacion: Place the balls inside a six metre central circle. One or two guardians stand inside the circle. The other players wait around it without balls.
ejercicios.desarrollo: On the signal, attackers enter to collect a ball and dribble it outside the circle. Guardians may tag an attacker before the exit. A tagged player returns the ball to the treasure and immediately tries again. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Enter in pairs; require an exit of a specific color; allow guardians to defend only the ball.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Feint before entering, protect the collected ball and avoid unnecessary physical contact.
ejercicios.consejo: Change the guardians every 45 seconds. Their role requires high effort and should remain dynamic.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Work simultaneously on shielding, awareness of opponents and quick footwork.
ejercicios.organizacion: Mark out a 14 to 18 metre square. Every player enters with a ball.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Each player protects the ball while trying to knock other balls out of the square. When a ball leaves the area, that player completes five quick touches outside and immediately returns. Count the balls won during each 45-second round. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Use only the weaker foot; reduce the square; play in teams and add the scores.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Challenge the ball, not the legs; keep the knees bent and use the body as a shield.
ejercicios.consejo: Immediate re-entry maintains activity. Avoid any version where eliminated players remain on the side for

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Introduce possession and collective movement through a simple rule.
ejercicios.organizacion: Create two teams of four to six players in an appropriate area. Add two small target zones at the ends.
ejercicios.desarrollo: A team scores after three consecutive passes followed by a reception inside a target zone. After a point or the ball leaves the area, possession quickly restarts with the other team. Play four rounds of 90 seconds. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Maximum two touches; bonus point if every player touches the ball; add a neutral player.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use the width, provide several options for the ball carrier and react immediately after losing possession.
ejercicios.consejo: Enlarge the field if the players cannot complete three passes; reduce it if the pressure is too low.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Activate movement while circulating the ball from one zone to another.
ejercicios.organizacion: Divide the field into three bands. Create two teams and, when possible, add a neutral player who supports the team in possession.
ejercicios.desarrollo: To score, a team must move the ball through all three zones without returning to the same zone twice in a row. Players may change zones after every pass. Restart immediately after an interception. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Limit each zone to three players; require a forward pass; score after completing a full out-and-back sequence.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Move after passing, occupy the width and avoid everyone following the ball into the same band.
ejercicios.consejo: The zone rule should guide movement, not trap players. Allow frequent changes of zone.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Improve passing to a moving teammate and body orientation.
ejercicios.organizacion: Inside a 12 metre square, three players keep possession against a passive or active defender. A target player moves along one outside edge.
ejercicios.desarrollo: The group scores when it finds the moving target after at least two passes. The passer becomes the new target and the previous target enters the square. Change the defender every minute. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Use targets on two sides; make the defender active; allow only one-touch passes to the target.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Scan the target’s movement, prepare the passing angle and play into the path rather than directly to the feet.
ejercicios.consejo: Start with a passive defender if the group is learning the game, then increase the pressure gradually.

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Finish the opening phase with high collective intensity and many decisions.
ejercicios.organizacion: Prepare two or three small 18 x 12 metre fields. Create teams of three or four players. Each field has two mini-goals or four gates.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Play 90-second matches. At each signal, teams quickly change opponents or fields. Put another ball in play immediately after it leaves the field to maintain the tempo.
ejercicios.variantes: A goal counts after three passes; maximum two touches; bonus for winning the ball in the opposition half.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Use few rules, quick rotations, spare balls around the fields and controlled contact.
ejercicios.consejo: Explain the rotations before starting. The change between matches should take no more than twenty

ejercicios.fuente: Prime Group · 25 Games to Start Training
ejercicios.objetivo: Provide a complete opening routine when preparation time is limited.
ejercicios.organizacion: Prepare a central square, several gates and a small field. Keep all equipment in place to move from one phase to the next without interruption.
ejercicios.desarrollo: Minutes 1 to 3: free dribbling and mobility. Minutes 4 to 6: magic gates with changes of pace. Minutes 7 to 9: passing in pairs while moving. Minutes 10 to 12: possession game or high-intensity 3v3. GAME DIAGRAM
ejercicios.variantes: Adapt the final phase to the session theme; extend each block to four minutes; use the weaker foot in the second block.
ejercicios.puntos_clave: Progressive intensity, very short transitions and instructions given before the next block starts.
